Use a permanent marker to label the boxes. 用永久记号笔给箱子贴标签。 | per->彻底，man->留（拉丁manere），permanent->彻底留下来的=永久的（cf. remain留下，manor庄园，immanent内在） || 文化联想：中国搬家时用油性记号笔给纸箱写字最适合帮助记忆 permanent，可以说 **a permanent marker — “A mover may use a permanent marker to label boxes so the writing will not rub off easily.”**

quiz.question: impermanent ___
quiz.explanation: 暂时的; 非永久的, 非永久性艺术. Sand mandalas are beautiful impermanent art forms. 沙坛城是美丽的非永久性艺术形式。 | im->否定，permanent->永久的，impermanent->非永久的=短暂的（cf. permanent永久，temporary暂时） || 文化联想：藏传佛教沙坛城最适合帮助记忆 impermanent，可以说 **impermanent art — “A sand mandala is a striking example of impermanent art because it is carefully created and later deliberately dismantled.”**

quiz.question: eminent _______
quiz.explanation: 杰出的; 著名的, 杰出的学者. The eminent scholar published groundbreaking research. 杰出的学者发表了开创性的研究。 | e->向外，min->突出（拉丁eminere），eminent->突出显眼的=杰出的（cf. prominent突出，imminent迫近，preeminent卓越） || 文化联想：钱学森、华罗庚等著名学者的公众形象最适合帮助记忆 eminent，可以说 **an eminent scholar — “An eminent scholar may influence a field through major discoveries, influential teaching, and decades of research.”**

quiz.question: preeminent _______
quiz.explanation: 卓越的; 杰出的, 杰出的学者. She is the preeminent scholar in her field. 她是该领域卓越的学者。 | pre->更加，eminent->杰出的，preeminent->比杰出更突出的=卓越的（cf. eminent杰出，prominent突出，transcendent超越） || 文化联想：中文“首屈一指的学者”最适合帮助记忆 preeminent，可以说 **a preeminent scholar — “A researcher whose work defines an entire field may become its preeminent scholar.”**

quiz.question: imminent ______
quiz.explanation: 即将发生的; 迫近的, 迫在眉睫的危险. The residents faced imminent danger from the hurricane. 居民面临飓风带来的迫在眉睫的危险。 | im->进入，min->突出/悬挂（拉丁），imminent->悬在上面即将落下的=迫近的（注意区分eminent杰出，immanent内在） || 文化联想：中文“山雨欲来、危险迫在眉睫”最适合帮助记忆 imminent，可以说 **imminent danger — “Residents may evacuate when authorities warn that a landslide poses imminent danger after days of heavy rain.”**

quiz.question: ___ _______ continent
quiz.explanation: 大陆; 洲, 非洲大陆. Wildlife is abundant on the African continent. 非洲大陆野生动物丰富。 | con->共同，tinent->持有（拉丁tenere），continent->持续持有土地的=大陆（cf. contain容纳，retain保留，pertinent相关） || 文化联想：中国地理课里的亚欧大陆最适合帮助记忆 continent，可以说 **the Asian continent — “China occupies a vast part of the Asian continent and contains many different climate zones.”**

quiz.question: pertinent ________
quiz.explanation: 相关的; 切题的, 相关的问题. She asked a pertinent question about the policy. 她问了一个关于该政策的相关问题。 | per->彻底，tinent->持有（拉丁tenere），pertinent->牢牢持在话题上的=相关的（cf. pertain相关，pertinacious执着，continent大陆） || 文化联想：中文“切中要害”最适合帮助记忆 pertinent，可以说 **a pertinent question — “A good interviewer asks a pertinent question that goes directly to the central issue.”**

quiz.question: abstinent _________
quiz.explanation: 节制的; 戒除的, 节制的生活方式. He maintained an abstinent lifestyle for health reasons. 出于健康原因,他保持节制的生活方式。 | abs->离开，tinent->持有，abstinent->不持有/不接触的=节制的（cf. abstain弃权，abstinence禁欲，abstentious节制） || 文化联想：中文“滴酒不沾、长期节制”最适合帮助记忆 abstinent，可以说 **an abstinent lifestyle — “Someone who chooses not to drink alcohol at all may maintain an abstinent lifestyle for health or personal reasons.”**

quiz.question: ____ exponent
quiz.explanation: 指数; 倡导者, 数学指数. Students learn about math exponent in algebra. 学生在代数中学习数学指数。 | ex->向外，pon->放置（拉丁ponere），exponent->放在外面展示的=指数/倡导者（cf. expose暴露，component组成，postpone延迟） || 文化联想：中国中学代数里的“指数”最适合帮助记忆 exponent，可以说 **a mathematical exponent — “In algebra, a mathematical exponent tells how many times a base is multiplied by itself.”**

quiz.question: repent ___
quiz.explanation: 悔改; 后悔, 忏悔罪过. The penitent came to repent sin. 悔罪者来忏悔罪过。 | re->再次，pent->痛苦（拉丁poenitere），repent->再次感受痛苦=悔改（cf. penitent悔罪的，penal惩罚的，penalty惩罚） || 文化联想：中文“知错能改、真心悔过”最适合帮助记忆 repent，可以说 **repent of wrongdoing — “Someone who truly regrets causing harm may repent of wrongdoing and try to make amends.”**

quiz.question: _____ adherent
quiz.explanation: 拥护者; 信徒, 政党拥护者. He remained a loyal party adherent. 他仍然是忠诚的政党拥护者。 | ad->朝向，her->粘（拉丁haerere），adherent->粘附其上的人=拥护者（cf. adhere坚持，adhesive粘合剂，coherent连贯，cohesion凝聚） || 文化联想：中文“忠实拥护者”最适合帮助记忆 adherent，可以说 **a loyal adherent — “A loyal adherent of a school of thought may continue defending its core ideas for many years.”**

quiz.question: coherent ________
quiz.explanation: 连贯的; 一致的, 连贯的论点. She presented a coherent argument to the committee. 她向委员会提出了连贯的论点。 | co->共同，her->粘，coherent->粘在一起的=连贯的（cf. adhere坚持，incoherent语无伦次，cohesion凝聚力） || 文化联想：中文“条理清楚、前后连贯”最适合帮助记忆 coherent，可以说 **a coherent argument — “A strong essay presents a coherent argument in which each point follows logically from the previous one.”**

quiz.question: abhorrent _____
quiz.explanation: 可憎的; 令人厌恶的, 可憎的罪行. Murder is an abhorrent crime to civilized society. 谋杀对文明社会来说是可憎的罪行。 | ab->离开，hor->恐惧（拉丁horrere），abhorrent->让人因恐惧而退避的=可憎的（cf. horror恐惧，abhor憎恶，horrible可怕） || 文化联想：中文“令人发指、无法接受”最适合帮助记忆 abhorrent，可以说 **an abhorrent crime — “Deliberately exploiting vulnerable people can be condemned as an abhorrent crime.”**

quiz.question: _ torrent __ _____
quiz.explanation: 洪流; 急流, 一连串辱骂. He faced a torrent of abuse from critics. 他面临来自批评者的一连串辱骂。 | torr->奔涌（拉丁torrere->奔流），torrent->奔涌的急流=洪流（cf. torrential倾盆的，torrid炎热的，torrent of words话语洪流） || 文化联想：中文“铺天盖地的一阵辱骂”最适合帮助记忆 torrent，可以说 **a torrent of abuse — “A public figure may receive a torrent of abuse online after a highly controversial statement.”**

quiz.question: misrepresent _____
quiz.explanation: 歪曲; 误传, 歪曲事实. The article deliberately misrepresent facts. 这篇文章故意歪曲事实。 | mis->错误，re->再，present->呈现，misrepresent->错误地呈现=歪曲（cf. represent代表，present呈现，misinterpret误读） || 文化联想：中文“歪曲事实”最适合帮助记忆 misrepresent，可以说 **misrepresent the facts — “Leaving out crucial evidence can misrepresent the facts even if every individual sentence is technically true.”**

quiz.question: omnipresent ______
quiz.explanation: 无所不在的, 无所不在的危险. Terrorism poses an omnipresent danger in modern times. 恐怖主义在现代构成无所不在的危险。 | omni->全部，present->在场，omnipresent->无处不在场的（cf. omniscient全知，omnipotent全能，omnivore杂食动物） || 文化联想：中文“无处不在”最适合帮助记忆 omnipresent，可以说 **an omnipresent presence — “Smartphones can feel omnipresent in modern urban life because people carry them almost everywhere.”**

quiz.question: ____ consent
quiz.explanation: 同意; 准许, 给予同意. Parents must give consent for the field trip. 家长必须对实地考察给予同意。 | con->共同，sent->感觉，consent->共同感觉=同意（cf. assent赞成，dissent异议，sentiment情感，consensus共识） || 文化联想：中国学校组织校外活动时需要家长同意最适合帮助记忆 consent，可以说 **give consent — “Parents may need to give consent before a child joins an overnight school trip.”**

quiz.question: ____ assent
quiz.explanation: 同意; 赞成, 给予同意. The board will give assent to the proposal. 董事会将对该提案给予同意。 | as->朝向，sent->感觉，assent->朝向同意的感觉=赞成（cf. consent同意，dissent异议，resent怨恨，presentiment预感） || 文化联想：中文“正式表示赞成”最适合帮助记忆 assent，可以说 **give assent — “After reviewing the proposal, every board member may give assent to the final version.”**

quiz.question: _____ dissent
quiz.explanation: 异议; 不同意, 表达异议. Several members will voice dissent from the decision. 几位成员将对该决定表达异议。 | dis->不同，sent->感觉，dissent->感觉不同=异议（cf. consent同意，assent赞成，dissident异见者，consensus共识） || 文化联想：中文“保留不同意见、公开表达异议”最适合帮助记忆 dissent，可以说 **voice dissent — “A committee member may voice dissent when the majority supports a policy that she believes is mistaken.”**

quiz.question: latent ______
quiz.explanation: 潜在的; 隐藏的, 潜在缺陷. The product had a latent defect not visible initially. 该产品有一个最初看不见的潜在缺陷。 | latent->隐藏的（拉丁latere->藏），latent->潜伏的（cf. latent heat潜热，lateral侧面的，latitude纬度=宽阔之处） || 文化联想：中国买房验房时最怕一开始看不出的隐藏缺陷，最适合帮助记忆 latent，可以说 **a latent defect — “A leaking pipe hidden behind a wall may be a latent defect that appears only months after purchase.”**

quiz.question: incompetent __________
quiz.explanation: 无能的; 不称职的, 无能的管理. Incompetent management led to the companys failure. 无能的管理导致了公司的失败。 | in->否定，competent->有能力的（con+pet->共同追求），incompetent->没有能力的（cf. compete竞争，competent称职，petition请求） || 文化联想：中文“外行领导内行、管理无能”最适合帮助记忆 incompetent，可以说 **incompetent management — “A company can fail despite a good product when incompetent management repeatedly makes poor decisions.”**

quiz.question: penitent __________
quiz.explanation: 悔过的; 忏悔的, 悔过的表情. The criminal wore a penitent expression in court. 罪犯在法庭上带着悔过的表情。 | penit->痛苦（拉丁poenitere），penitent->感到痛悔的（cf. repent悔改，penitentiary监狱=悔过之所，penalty惩罚） || 文化联想：中文“真心悔过的样子”最适合帮助记忆 penitent，可以说 **a penitent expression — “A defendant who sincerely regrets the harm caused may appear in court with a penitent expression.”**

quiz.question: impenitent ______
quiz.explanation: 不悔悟的, 不悔悟的罪人. The impenitent sinner showed no remorse. 不悔悟的罪人没有表现出悔恨。 | im->否定，penitent->悔悟的，impenitent->不悔悟的（cf. penitent悔罪，repent悔改，unrepentant不悔改的） || 文化联想：中文“死不悔改”最适合帮助记忆 impenitent，可以说 **an impenitent offender — “An impenitent offender may continue to justify harmful behavior even after being confronted with the consequences.”**

quiz.question: ____ intent
quiz.explanation: 意图; 目的, 善意. Despite good intent, the plan failed. 尽管有善意,计划还是失败了。 | in->进入，tent->伸展（拉丁tendere），intent->伸向某处的心思=意图（cf. intend意图，extend延伸，intention意图，attentive专注） || 文化联想：中文“好心办坏事”最适合帮助记忆 intent，可以说 **good intent — “A plan can fail despite good intent if the people designing it do not understand the real problem.”**

quiz.question: _ malcontent _______
quiz.explanation: 不满者, 不满派系. A malcontent faction plotted against the leader. 不满派系密谋反对领导者。 | mal->坏，content->满足，malcontent->不满足的人（cf. content内容/满足，discontented不满足，countenance面容/容忍） || 文化联想：中文“满腹牢骚、心怀不满的人”最适合帮助记忆 malcontent，可以说 **a political malcontent — “A chronic malcontent may criticize every leader without ever proposing a workable alternative.”**

quiz.question: omnipotent _____
quiz.explanation: 全能的, 全能的神. Many religions worship an omnipotent deity. 许多宗教崇拜全能的神。 | omni->全部，pot->力量（拉丁potere），omnipotent->有全部力量的=全能的（cf. impotent无力，potent强大，omniscient全知） || 文化联想：omnipotent 是宗教“全能”概念，可用中国学生学习世界宗教时来记忆，可以说 **an omnipotent deity — “In theology, some traditions describe God as an omnipotent deity with unlimited power.”**

quiz.question: consistent _______
quiz.explanation: 一致的; 连续的, 一致的模式. The data shows a consistent pattern over time. 数据显示随时间推移的一致模式。 | con->共同，sist->站立，consistent->始终共同站立的=一致的（cf. insist坚持，persist坚持，resist抵制，assist协助） || 文化联想：中文“一以贯之、前后一致”最适合帮助记忆 consistent，可以说 **a consistent pattern — “If the same result appears month after month, the data may show a consistent pattern.”**

quiz.question: remittent _____
quiz.explanation: 间歇性的, 间歇性发热. The patient suffered from remittent fever. 患者遭受间歇性发热。 | re->回，mitt->送，remittent->时退时来的=间歇性的（cf. remit汇款，intermittent间断，submit提交，emit发射） || 文化联想：中国医院里体温持续偏高但会反复波动的发热最适合帮助记忆 remittent，可以说 **a remittent fever — “A remittent fever may rise and fall during the day without returning fully to normal.”**

quiz.question: intermittent ____
quiz.explanation: 间歇的; 断断续续的, 间歇性降雨. Intermittent rain fell throughout the day. 整天都有间歇性降雨。 | inter->之间，mitt->送，intermittent->断断续续发送的=间歇的（cf. remittent间歇性，submit提交，emit发射，transmit传输） || 文化联想：江南梅雨季时下时停的雨最适合帮助记忆 intermittent，可以说 **intermittent rain — “Intermittent rain may stop for an hour and then begin again several times during the day.”**

quiz.question: _______ unguent
quiz.explanation: 软膏; 油膏, 治疗软膏. The herbalist prepared a healing unguent. 草药师准备了治疗软膏。 | ung->涂油（拉丁ungere），unguent->涂抹用的油膏（cf. ointment软膏=同根，anoint涂圣油，ungulate有蹄动物=用蹄踢） || 文化联想：中国传统药膏和草药膏剂最适合帮助记忆 unguent，可以说 **a herbal unguent — “A traditional apothecary might prepare a herbal unguent to be applied externally to the skin.”**

quiz.question: frequent _____
quiz.explanation: 频繁的; 常见的, 常旅客. She earned points as a frequent flyer. 她作为常旅客赚取积分。 | frequent->频繁（拉丁frequens->满满的），frequent->经常发生的（cf. frequency频率，infrequent不频繁，seldom很少） || 文化联想：中国经常坐飞机出差的人最适合帮助记忆 frequent，可以说 **a frequent flyer — “A consultant who travels between Beijing and Shanghai every week may become a frequent flyer.”**

quiz.question: subsequent ______
quiz.explanation: 随后的; 后来的, 随后的事件. Subsequent events proved him right. 随后的事件证明他是对的。 | sub->在后，sequ->跟随，subsequent->跟随在后的=随后的（cf. sequence序列，sequel续集，consequence后果，obsequious谄媚） || 文化联想：中文“后来发生的事证明了前面的判断”最适合帮助记忆 subsequent，可以说 **subsequent events — “Subsequent events may prove that an early warning was more accurate than people first believed.”**

quiz.question: ________ delinquent
quiz.explanation: 拖欠的; 违法者, 少年犯. The juvenile delinquent was sent to reform school. 少年犯被送到少年管教所。 | de->向下，linqu->放弃（拉丁linquere），delinquent->放弃责任的人=违法者（cf. relinquish放弃，dereliction失职，relic遗迹） || 文化联想：中文“少年违法者”最适合帮助记忆 delinquent，可以说 **a juvenile delinquent — “A juvenile delinquent may be placed in a rehabilitation program focused on education and behavior change.”**

quiz.question: magniloquent ______
quiz.explanation: 夸张的; 浮夸的, 夸张的演讲. His magniloquent speech impressed no one. 他夸张的演讲没有打动任何人。 | magni->大，loqu->说（拉丁loqui），magniloquent->说大话的=夸张的（cf. eloquent雄辩，colloquial口语，circumlocution迂回说法） || 文化联想：中文“满口大话、辞藻浮夸”最适合帮助记忆 magniloquent，可以说 **a magniloquent speech — “A speaker who uses grand words but says very little of substance may deliver a magniloquent speech.”**

quiz.question: congruent _________
quiz.explanation: 全等的; 一致的, 全等三角形. The geometry lesson covered congruent triangles. 几何课涵盖了全等三角形。 | con->共同，gru->走（拉丁gradi），congruent->共同走向=全等的（cf. incongruent不全等，congruence一致性，congress会议） || 文化联想：中国中学几何课里的全等三角形最适合帮助记忆 congruent，可以说 **congruent triangles — “Two congruent triangles have exactly the same shape and size even if one is rotated or reflected.”**

quiz.question: incongruent ________
quiz.explanation: 不一致的; 不协调的, 不全等三角形. The incongruent triangle cannot match the other. 不全等三角形无法与另一个匹配。 | in->否定，congruent->全等，incongruent->不全等/不一致（cf. congruent全等，incongruous不协调，congruence一致） || 文化联想：中文“放在一起明显不协调”最适合帮助记忆 incongruent，可以说 **incongruent elements — “Modern neon signs may look incongruent beside a carefully restored ancient wooden facade.”**

quiz.question: ___ constituent
quiz.explanation: 组成部分; 选民, 关键成分. Water is a key constituent of the mixture. 水是混合物的关键成分。 | con->共同，stitu->建立（拉丁），constituent->共同建立的部分=成分/选民（cf. constitute构成，institution机构，statute法规） || 文化联想：中文“关键组成部分”最适合帮助记忆 constituent，可以说 **a key constituent — “Water is a key constituent of many foods, tissues, and chemical mixtures.”**

quiz.question: vent ___________
quiz.explanation: 通风口; 发泄, 发泄挫折感. He needed to vent frustration after the loss. 失利后他需要发泄挫折感。 | vent->风/出口（拉丁ventus->风），vent->使气体流出=通风/发泄（cf. ventilate通风，invent发明=向内吹入，event事件=出来的事） || 文化联想：中文“找朋友吐槽一下、发泄情绪”最适合帮助记忆 vent，可以说 **vent frustration — “After a stressful day, someone may call a close friend to vent frustration before calming down.”**

quiz.question: ___ advent __
quiz.explanation: 到来; 出现, 到来. The advent of technology changed everything. 技术的到来改变了一切。 | ad->朝向，vent->来（拉丁venire），advent->到来（cf. event事件，prevent阻止=提前到来，adventure冒险=向前走） || 文化联想：中国互联网和智能手机普及的到来最适合帮助记忆 advent，可以说 **the advent of smartphones — “The advent of smartphones changed how many people in China shop, pay, communicate, and travel.”**

quiz.question: _______ solvent
quiz.explanation: 溶剂; 有偿付能力的, 有机溶剂. The chemist used an organic solvent in the experiment. 化学家在实验中使用了有机溶剂。 | solv->松开/溶解（拉丁solvere），solvent->能溶解的物质=溶剂（cf. solve解决，resolve决心，dissolve溶解，solution溶液） || 文化联想：中国化学实验室里的有机溶剂最适合帮助记忆 solvent，可以说 **an organic solvent — “A chemist may use an organic solvent to dissolve a compound before purification or analysis.”**

quiz.question: circumvent ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 规避; 绕过, 规避规则. They tried to circumvent the rules through loopholes. 他们试图通过漏洞规避规则。 | circum->绕圈，vent->来，circumvent->绕圈绕过=规避（cf. prevent阻止，invent发明，event事件，advent到来） || 文化联想：中文“钻空子、绕过规则”最适合帮助记忆 circumvent，可以说 **circumvent the rules — “A company that creates a fake arrangement merely to avoid a regulation may be trying to circumvent the rules.”**

quiz.question: _________ restraint
quiz.explanation: 克制; 约束, 情感克制. She showed remarkable emotional restraint. 她表现出非凡的情感克制。 | re->回，strain->拉紧（拉丁stringere），restraint->拉回=克制（cf. restrain抑制，constrain限制，strain紧张，restrict限制） || 文化联想：中文“喜怒不形于色、保持克制”最适合帮助记忆 restraint，可以说 **emotional restraint — “An experienced negotiator may show emotional restraint even when the discussion becomes heated.”**

quiz.question: _____ constraint
quiz.explanation: 约束; 限制, 严格的约束. The project faced tight constraint on time and budget. 该项目面临时间和预算的严格约束。 | con->共同，strain->拉紧，constraint->共同拉紧=约束（cf. restrain克制，strain紧张，stringent严格，constrict收缩） || 文化联想：中文“时间和预算都卡得很紧”最适合帮助记忆 constraint，可以说 **a tight constraint — “A small engineering team may face a tight constraint on both time and budget.”**

quiz.question: acquaint ____ _____
quiz.explanation: 使熟悉, 使熟悉规则. New employees must acquaint with rules and procedures. 新员工必须熟悉规则和程序。 | ac->朝向，quaint->知晓（拉丁cognoscere），acquaint->使知晓=使熟悉（cf. quaint古朴，acquaintance相识，cognize认知） || 文化联想：中国新员工入职先熟悉规章流程最适合帮助记忆 acquaint，可以说 **acquaint oneself with the rules — “A new employee should acquaint herself with the rules and procedures before handling sensitive work.”**

quiz.question: ______ flint
quiz.explanation: 燧石, 击打燧石. Early humans struck flint to make sparks. 早期人类击打燧石制造火花。 | flint->燧石（古英语flint），flint->坚硬的燧石（cf. flinty冷酷无情的=像燧石一样硬，flintlock燧发枪，skinflint吝啬鬼） || 文化联想：中国考古和野外生存课程里敲击燧石取火最适合帮助记忆 flint，可以说 **strike flint — “In a survival demonstration, an instructor may strike flint against steel to produce sparks.”**

quiz.question: skinflint ________
quiz.explanation: 吝啬鬼; 守财奴, 吝啬的房东. The skinflint landlord refused all repairs. 吝啬的房东拒绝所有维修。 | skin->皮，flint->燧石，skinflint->连燧石皮都要剥下来的人=吝啬鬼（cf. miser守财奴，penny-pincher抠门，flint燧石） || 文化联想：中文“铁公鸡、一毛不拔”最适合帮助记忆 skinflint，可以说 **a skinflint landlord — “A skinflint landlord may refuse even inexpensive repairs despite collecting full rent every month.”**

quiz.question: _______ mint
quiz.explanation: 薄荷; 铸币厂, 新铸造的. The coins were freshly mint at the facility. 硬币在设施中新铸造。 | moneta->铸币（拉丁，Juno Moneta神庙旁的铸币厂），mint->铸币厂/薄荷（cf. money金钱，monetary货币，mint condition全新状态） || 文化联想：中国古代铸币场景最适合帮助记忆 mint，可以说 **a coin mint — “A historical mint could cast or strike coins bearing the official marks of the issuing authority.”**

quiz.question: appoint _ _________
quiz.explanation: 任命; 委派, 任命委员会. The board will appoint a committee to investigate. 董事会将任命委员会进行调查。 | ap->朝向，point->指向，appoint->指向某人=任命（cf. disappoint失望=没有指向，appointment约会，pointed尖锐的） || 文化联想：中国公司成立专项调查小组最适合帮助记忆 appoint，可以说 **appoint a committee — “A board may appoint a committee to investigate a serious compliance problem independently.”**

quiz.question: _______ imprint
quiz.explanation: 印记; 痕迹, 公司印记. The book bore the company imprint on its spine. 这本书的书脊上有公司印记。 | im->进入，print->印，imprint->深深印入=印记（cf. print印刷，blueprint蓝图，fingerprint指纹，footprint足迹） || 文化联想：中文“留下深刻印记”最适合帮助记忆 imprint，可以说 **leave an imprint — “A memorable teacher can leave an imprint on a student’s way of thinking for decades.”**

quiz.question: sprint ______
quiz.explanation: 冲刺, 冲刺终点. The runner accelerated for a sprint finish. 跑步者加速进行冲刺终点。 | sprint->冲刺（古挪威spretta->跳起），sprint->全速短跑（cf. spread蔓延，spring弹跳，spurt喷出，sprint短跑冲刺） || 文化联想：中国田径比赛最后一百米冲刺最适合帮助记忆 sprint，可以说 **a sprint finish — “A runner may save energy for a sprint finish during the final stretch of a close race.”**

quiz.question: ___ _ tint
quiz.explanation: 色调; 淡色, 添加色调. The artist will add a tint of blue to the painting. 艺术家将在画中添加蓝色色调。 | tinct->染色（拉丁tingere），tint->轻微染色=色调（cf. tincture酊剂，stain染色，dye染料，tinge轻微染色） || 文化联想：中国水墨画里淡淡的一层蓝色最适合帮助记忆 tint，可以说 **a blue tint — “A painter may add a blue tint to distant mountains to make the scene feel cooler and more atmospheric.”**

quiz.question: stint __
quiz.explanation: 限制; 节省, 在...上节省. Do not stint on quality when building a home. 建造房屋时不要在质量上节省。 | stint->限制（古英语styntan->使迟钝），stint->吝啬/限制（cf. stunt特技/阻碍，stunted发育不良，without stint毫不吝惜） || 文化联想：中文“质量上绝不能省”最适合帮助记忆 stint，可以说 **not stint on quality — “When renovating a home, a careful owner should not stint on quality for wiring, waterproofing, or structural work.”**

quiz.question: upfront ____
quiz.explanation: 预付的; 坦率的, 预付费用. The upfront cost was higher than expected. 预付费用高于预期。 | up->向上，front->前面，upfront->放在最前面的=预付/坦率的（cf. front前面，confront对抗，affront冒犯，frontline前线） || 文化联想：中国买车、装修时常见的一次性前期费用最适合帮助记忆 upfront，可以说 **an upfront cost — “A renovation may have a high upfront cost even if it reduces maintenance expenses later.”**

quiz.question: __ wont __
quiz.explanation: 习惯于; 惯常的, 习惯于. He is wont to rise early every morning. 他习惯于每天早上早起。 | wont->习惯（古英语wunian->居住/习惯于），wont->惯常的（cf. accustomed习惯于，custom习惯，won't will not的缩写，注意区分） || 文化联想：中文“习以为常、惯常如此”最适合帮助记忆 wont，可以说 **be wont to — “An elderly neighbor may be wont to take the same morning walk through the park every day.”**

quiz.question: flaunt ______
quiz.explanation: 炫耀; 夸示, 炫耀财富. She loves to flaunt wealth with expensive cars. 她喜欢用昂贵的汽车炫耀财富。 | flaunt->炫耀（来源不明，可能来自flant->飘动），flaunt->大胆炫耀（注意flaunt≠flout，flout藐视，两词常混淆） || 文化联想：中文“炫富”最适合帮助记忆 flaunt，可以说 **flaunt wealth — “Someone who constantly posts luxury cars and watches online may be trying to flaunt wealth.”**

quiz.question: blunt __________
quiz.explanation: 钝的; 直率的, 钝器. The murder weapon was a blunt instrument. 凶器是一件钝器。 | blunt->钝（古挪威blundr->闭眼），blunt->使钝/直率（cf. bland温和，blind瞎，blunder错误=不看路走的错） || 文化联想：中国刑侦剧里“钝器伤”是很直观的记忆点，可以说 **a blunt instrument — “Investigators may identify a heavy metal bar as a blunt instrument used in an assault.”**

quiz.question: discount _______
quiz.explanation: 折扣; 低估, 大幅打折. The store will discount heavily during the sale. 商店在促销期间将大幅打折。 | dis->否定，count->计算，discount->不全计算=打折/低估（cf. count计数，recount重述，account账目） || 文化联想：中国电商大促里“全场打折”最适合帮助记忆 discount，可以说 **discount heavily — “During a major online shopping festival, a store may discount heavily to attract buyers.”**

quiz.question: paramount __________
quiz.explanation: 至高无上的; 最重要的, 至关重要. Safety is of paramount importance in construction. 安全在建筑中至关重要。 | para->通过，mount->山（法语，拉丁mons），paramount->超过所有山峰的=至高无上（cf. amount总量，surmount克服，paramount领导） || 文化联想：中国工地常说“安全第一”，最适合帮助记忆 paramount，可以说 **of paramount importance — “On a construction site, worker safety is of paramount importance.”**

quiz.question: tantamount __
quiz.explanation: 等同于; 相当于, 等同于. His silence was tantamount to admission of guilt. 他的沉默等同于承认有罪。 | tant->如此多（法语tant），amount->数量，tantamount->数量如此相同=等同于（cf. amount总量，paramount至高，cf. equivalent等价） || 文化联想：中文“这几乎等同于默认”最适合帮助记忆 tantamount，可以说 **tantamount to admission — “Refusing to deny a charge in a situation that clearly requires an answer may be tantamount to admission.”**

quiz.question: surmount ____________
quiz.explanation: 克服; 战胜, 克服困难. They managed to surmount difficulties and succeed. 他们设法克服困难并取得成功。 | sur->超过，mount->山，surmount->爬过山峰=克服（cf. mount攀登，paramount至高，insurmountable不可克服的） || 文化联想：中文“翻过一座山、克服难关”最适合帮助记忆 surmount，可以说 **surmount difficulties — “A determined student may surmount difficulties one by one and eventually complete a demanding degree.”**

quiz.question: ____ ___ brunt
quiz.explanation: 首当其冲, 承受冲击. The coastal towns will bear the brunt of the storm. 沿海城镇将首当其冲承受风暴。 | brunt->冲击（来源不明，可能古挪威brynr->烫），brunt->冲击的最强部分，bear the brunt->承受最猛烈的冲击 || 文化联想：中文“首当其冲”最适合帮助记忆 brunt，可以说 **bear the brunt — “Coastal towns often bear the brunt of a typhoon when it first makes landfall.”**

quiz.question: ______ stunt
quiz.explanation: 阻碍; 特技, 生长受阻. Malnutrition can growth stunt in children. 营养不良会导致儿童生长受阻。 | stunt->使迟钝/阻碍（古英语styntan），stunt->特技/阻碍生长（cf. stint节省，stunted矮小的，stunt double替身演员） || 文化联想：中国儿童营养不良会影响长高，最适合帮助记忆 stunt，可以说 **stunt growth — “Severe malnutrition can stunt growth in children by depriving the body of essential nutrients.”**

quiz.question: _________ bigot
quiz.explanation: 偏执者; 顽固者, 宗教偏执者. The religious bigot refused to tolerate other faiths. 宗教偏执者拒绝容忍其他信仰。 | bigot->偏执者（法语bigot，可能来自"by God"的誓言），bigot->对自己信仰盲目执着（cf. bigotry偏执，intolerant不宽容） || 文化联想：中文“偏执到容不下不同意见的人”最适合帮助记忆 bigot，可以说 **a religious bigot — “A religious bigot may refuse to respect people whose beliefs are different from his own.”**

quiz.question: ______ argot
quiz.explanation: 黑话; 行话, 街头黑话. The criminals spoke in street argot. 罪犯用街头黑话交谈。 | argot->行话（法语，来源不明，可能来自ergot->麦角），argot->特定群体的黑话（cf. jargon行话，slang俚语，cant黑话） || 文化联想：中文“江湖黑话”最适合帮助记忆 argot，可以说 **street argot — “A crime novel may use street argot that outsiders find difficult to understand.”**

quiz.question: ____ patriot
quiz.explanation: 爱国者, 真正的爱国者. A true patriot serves his country selflessly. 真正的爱国者无私地为国家服务。 | patri->父亲/祖国（拉丁patria），patriot->热爱祖国的人=爱国者（cf. patriotism爱国主义，patron赞助人，paternal父亲的） || 文化联想：中文“真正爱国不是喊口号，而是尽责任”最适合帮助记忆 patriot，可以说 **a true patriot — “A true patriot can care deeply about the country while still taking civic responsibilities seriously.”**

quiz.question: ______ compatriot
quiz.explanation: 同胞; 同国人, 同胞. He met a fellow compatriot abroad. 他在国外遇到了一位同胞。 | com->共同，patriot->爱国者，compatriot->共同祖国的人=同胞（cf. patriot爱国者，expatriate海外居民=离开祖国） || 文化联想：中国人在海外偶遇同胞最适合帮助记忆 compatriot，可以说 **a fellow compatriot — “A traveler in a foreign city may feel an instant connection after meeting a fellow compatriot from China.”**

quiz.question: jot _ ____
quiz.explanation: 草草记下, 草草记下笔记. Let me jot a note to remind myself. 让我草草记下笔记提醒自己。 | jot->极小的量（希腊iota->最小的希腊字母），jot->一点/草草记下（cf. iota一点，not a jot一点也没有，jotting便条） || 文化联想：中文“随手记一下”最适合帮助记忆 jot，可以说 **jot a note — “A student may jot a note on a phone before the idea disappears.”**

quiz.question: _____ clot
quiz.explanation: 凝块, 血块. A blood clot can be dangerous if it travels. 如果血块移动,可能会很危险。 | clot->凝块（古英语clott->团块），clot->凝固成团块（cf. cloud云=水凝聚，clump丛/笨人，clutter杂乱） || 文化联想：中国医院里医生会警惕深静脉血栓最适合帮助记忆 clot，可以说 **a blood clot — “A blood clot in a deep vein can become dangerous if it travels to the lungs.”**

quiz.question: _______ helot
quiz.explanation: 奴隶; 农奴, 斯巴达奴隶. The Spartan helot worked the land for their masters. 斯巴达奴隶为主人耕种土地。 | Helot->希洛特（希腊，Helos城的被征服者），helot->斯巴达的国家农奴（cf. serf农奴，bondsman奴隶，Sparta斯巴达） || 文化联想：helot 是古代斯巴达社会里的农奴，可用中国学生学习古希腊史时来记忆，可以说 **a Spartan helot — “In a world-history class, students may learn that a Spartan helot worked the land under a system of forced servitude.”**

quiz.question: polyglot _________
quiz.explanation: 通晓多种语言的; 多语言的, 多语言社区. New York is a polyglot community with diverse cultures. 纽约是一个拥有多元文化的多语言社区。 | poly->多，glot->语言（希腊glotta），polyglot->多种语言的（cf. glottis声门，epiglottis会厌，glossary词汇表） || 文化联想：上海、深圳等国际化城市的多语言环境最适合帮助记忆 polyglot，可以说 **a polyglot community — “An international neighborhood in Shanghai may become a polyglot community where several languages are heard every day.”**

quiz.question: ____ _ ballot
quiz.explanation: 投票; 选票, 投票. Citizens will cast a ballot in the election. 公民将在选举中投票。 | ballot->小球（意大利ballotta->小球），ballot->原指投入箱中的小球=选票（cf. ball球，ballet芭蕾=小球=圆形的舞步） || 文化联想：中文“投下一票”最适合帮助记忆 ballot，可以说 **cast a ballot — “A voter may cast a ballot after checking the candidates and issues on the election paper.”**

quiz.question: plot _____
quiz.explanation: 情节; 阴谋, 情节转折. The movie features a surprising plot twist. 这部电影有一个令人惊讶的情节转折。 | plot->小块地/图谋（古英语plot），plot->情节/阴谋（cf. subplot子情节，plotter阴谋者，plot of land一块土地） || 文化联想：中国悬疑剧结尾突然反转最适合帮助记忆 plot，可以说 **a plot twist — “A crime drama may reveal a surprising plot twist in the final episode.”**

quiz.question: ____ slot
quiz.explanation: 槽; 时段, 时间段. The show airs in a prime time slot. 该节目在黄金时间段播出。 | slot->槽口（古法语esclot->槽），slot->插槽/时段（cf. slot machine老虎机，time slot时间段） || 文化联想：中文“黄金时段”最适合帮助记忆 slot，可以说 **a prime-time slot — “A popular television program may be given a prime-time slot in the evening schedule.”**

quiz.question: ________ despot
quiz.explanation: 暴君; 专制君主, 东方暴君. The Oriental despot ruled with absolute power. 东方暴君以绝对权力统治。 | despotes->主人（希腊，家族的主宰），despot->家主演变为暴君（cf. despotism专制，despotic专制的，cf. tyrant暴君） || 文化联想：中国历史教材里“桀纣式暴君”的形象最适合帮助记忆 despot，可以说 **a ruthless despot — “Traditional historical storytelling may portray an abusive ruler as a ruthless despot who ignores the suffering of the people.”**

quiz.question: apt __________
quiz.explanation: 恰当的; 易于的, 恰当的比较. Thats an apt comparison between the two situations. 这是对两种情况的恰当比较。 | apt->适合（拉丁aptus->适合的），apt->恰当的/聪明（cf. aptitude才能，adapt适应，inept笨拙，adept熟练） || 文化联想：中文“这个比喻很贴切”最适合帮助记忆 apt，可以说 **an apt comparison — “Calling a crowded Spring Festival railway station a human tide can be an apt comparison.”**

quiz.question: adapt _______
quiz.explanation: 适应; 改编, 快速适应. Animals must adapt quickly to survive climate change. 动物必须快速适应才能在气候变化中生存。 | ad->朝向，apt->适合，adapt->使变得适合=适应（cf. apt恰当，inept笨拙，adept熟练，aptitude才能） || 文化联想：中国城市和企业面对新技术时必须快速调整，最适合帮助记忆 adapt，可以说 **adapt quickly — “A small business may survive a sudden market change if it can adapt quickly.”**

quiz.question: rapt _________
quiz.explanation: 全神贯注的; 入迷的, 全神贯注的注意力. The audience listened with rapt attention. 观众全神贯注地倾听。 | rapt->被夺走（拉丁rapere->抓取），rapt->被迷住神魂夺走的=全神贯注（cf. rapture狂喜，rape掠夺，ravenous贪婪） || 文化联想：中文“听得入了迷、全神贯注”最适合帮助记忆 rapt，可以说 **rapt attention — “Children may listen with rapt attention when a skilled storyteller begins a suspenseful tale.”**

quiz.question: _____ precept
quiz.explanation: 准则; 戒律, 道德准则. He lived by the moral precept of honesty. 他按照诚实的道德准则生活。 | pre->提前，cept->抓取（拉丁capere），precept->提前抓住放在前面的=准则（cf. concept概念，except例外，intercept拦截） || 文化联想：“己所不欲，勿施于人”很适合作为 precept 的记忆钩子，可以说 **a moral precept — “‘Do not impose on others what you would not want yourself’ can serve as a moral precept.”**

quiz.question: intercept _ ____
quiz.explanation: 拦截; 截住, 拦截传球. The defender managed to intercept a pass. 防守队员设法拦截了传球。 | inter->之间，cept->抓，intercept->在中间抓住=拦截（cf. accept接受，except例外，concept概念，precept准则） || 文化联想：中国篮球比赛里防守球员抢断传球最适合帮助记忆 intercept，可以说 **intercept a pass — “A defender may intercept a pass and immediately start a fast break.”**

quiz.question: adept ______
quiz.explanation: 熟练的; 擅长的, 熟练的球员. She is an adept player with years of experience. 她是一位有多年经验的熟练球员。 | ad->朝向，ept->适合，adept->已经达到适合程度的=熟练（cf. apt恰当，adapt适应，inept不适合=笨拙） || 文化联想：中文“熟能生巧、很老练”最适合帮助记忆 adept，可以说 **an adept player — “After years of practice, a Go player may become adept at reading complex positions.”**

quiz.question: inept ________
quiz.explanation: 笨拙的; 无能的, 笨拙的处理. The inept handling of the crisis made things worse. 对危机的笨拙处理使情况变得更糟。 | in->否定，ept->适合，inept->不适合的=笨拙的（cf. apt恰当，adept熟练，adapt适应，inapt不恰当） || 文化联想：中文“处理得笨手笨脚、越搞越糟”最适合帮助记忆 inept，可以说 **inept handling — “Inept handling of a public complaint can turn a small problem into a major crisis.”**

quiz.question: ________ rescript
quiz.explanation: 敕令; 法令, 官方敕令. The emperor issued an official rescript. 皇帝发布了官方敕令。 | re->回，script->写，rescript->重新写出=答复文件/敕令（cf. script剧本，scripture圣经，prescribe开处方） || 文化联想：rescript 是旧式正式书面答复或敕令，可用中国学生学习古罗马与欧洲法律史时来记忆，可以说 **an official rescript — “In a legal-history course, students may encounter an official rescript issued in response to a formal petition.”**

quiz.question: conscript ____
quiz.explanation: 征召; 应征入伍者, 征召军队. The government decided to conscript army recruits. 政府决定征召军队新兵。 | con->共同，script->写，conscript->把名字写入名册=征召（cf. subscribe订阅，inscribe刻写，script剧本） || 文化联想：中国近现代史中的征兵制度最适合帮助记忆 conscript，可以说 **conscript young men — “During wartime, a government may conscript young men into military service.”**

quiz.question: _._. postscript
quiz.explanation: 附言; 后记, 附言. She added a P.S. postscript to her letter. 她在信中添加了附言。 | post->之后，script->写，postscript->写在后面的=附言（cf. manuscript手稿，prescribe处方，scripture圣经，P.S.=post scriptum） || 文化联想：中文书信里的“又及/P.S.”最适合帮助记忆 postscript，可以说 **add a postscript — “After finishing a letter, a writer may add a postscript with one final reminder.”**

quiz.question: ___________ manuscript
quiz.explanation: 手稿; 原稿, 手写手稿. The museum preserves a handwritten manuscript. 博物馆保存着一份手写手稿。 | manu->手，script->写，manuscript->用手写的=手稿（cf. manual手动，manufacture制造，manumit解放=从手中放开） || 文化联想：敦煌古写本最适合帮助记忆 manuscript，可以说 **a handwritten manuscript — “A handwritten manuscript from Dunhuang may preserve a text copied centuries ago.”**

quiz.question: sculpt _ ______
quiz.explanation: 雕刻; 雕塑, 雕刻人物. The artist will sculpt a figure from marble. 艺术家将用大理石雕刻人物。 | sculp->雕刻（拉丁sculpere），sculpt->雕刻（cf. sculpture雕塑，sculptor雕塑家，inscribe刻写） || 文化联想：中国雕塑家塑造人物泥稿最适合帮助记忆 sculpt，可以说 **sculpt a figure — “An artist may sculpt a figure in clay before casting the final work in bronze.”**

quiz.question: preempt ______
quiz.explanation: 抢先; 先发制人, 先发制人的打击. The military launched a preempt strike. 军方发动了先发制人的打击。 | pre->提前，empt->取得（拉丁emere->购买），preempt->提前购得=先发制人（cf. exempt豁免，redeem救赎，peremptory断然的） || 文化联想：中文“抢先一步、先发制人”最适合帮助记忆 preempt，可以说 **preempt a move — “A company may launch early to preempt a competitor’s planned move into the same market.”**

quiz.question: unkempt ____
quiz.explanation: 不整洁的; 蓬乱的, 蓬乱的头发. He arrived with unkempt hair and wrinkled clothes. 他到达时头发蓬乱,衣服皱巴巴的。 | un->否定，kempt->梳理（古英语cemban->梳），unkempt->未经梳理的=蓬乱（cf. kempt整洁，comb梳子，unkempt同根） || 文化联想：中文“头发乱得像鸡窝”最适合帮助记忆 unkempt，可以说 **unkempt hair — “A student who oversleeps may rush to class with unkempt hair and an untucked shirt.”**

quiz.question: prompt ________
quiz.explanation: 迅速的; 提示, 迅速的回应. We appreciate your prompt response to our inquiry. 我们感谢您对我们询问的迅速回应。 | pro->向前，empt->取/拿，prompt->向前推动=迅速的/提示（cf. prompter提词员，impromptu即兴=没有提示词） || 文化联想：中国客服讲究及时回应，最适合帮助记忆 prompt，可以说 **a prompt response — “A customer complaint is easier to resolve when the company gives a prompt response.”**

quiz.question: ____ excerpt
quiz.explanation: 摘录; 选段, 书籍摘录. The magazine published a book excerpt. 杂志发表了书籍摘录。 | ex->向外，cept->取，excerpt->向外取出的部分=摘录（cf. accept接受，intercept拦截，concept概念，except除外） || 文化联想：中国学生写论文时从书里摘录一段最适合帮助记忆 excerpt，可以说 **a book excerpt — “A teacher may assign a short book excerpt for students to analyze in class.”**

quiz.question: disrupt _______
quiz.explanation: 扰乱; 中断, 中断服务. Technical problems may disrupt service temporarily. 技术问题可能会暂时中断服务。 | dis->分开，rupt->破裂（拉丁rumpere），disrupt->从中间破裂=扰乱（cf. corrupt腐化，interrupt打断，erupt爆发，bankrupt破产） || 文化联想：中文“系统故障导致服务中断”最适合帮助记忆 disrupt，可以说 **disrupt service — “A major network failure can disrupt service for thousands of users.”**

quiz.question: ______ crypt
quiz.explanation: 地窖; 墓穴, 家族墓穴. The bodies were buried in the family crypt. 遗体被埋葬在家族墓穴中。 | crypt->隐藏（希腊kryptos），crypt->隐藏的地下室=墓穴（cf. cryptic神秘的，cryptocurrency加密货币，apocryphal伪作的） || 文化联想：crypt 是西方墓室概念，可用中国学生参观欧洲教堂地下墓室时来记忆，可以说 **a family crypt — “A visitor to an old European church may see a family crypt beneath the building.”**

quiz.question: dart _______
quiz.explanation: 飞镖; 猛冲, 向前猛冲. The rabbit will dart forward into the bushes. 兔子会向前猛冲进灌木丛。 | dart->投掷（古法语dard->标枪），dart->飞速冲去（cf. dash猛冲，dart board飞镖靶，blow dart吹箭） || 文化联想：中国武侠片里人物突然飞身向前最适合帮助记忆 dart，可以说 **dart forward — “A child chasing a ball may suddenly dart forward before an adult can stop him.”**

quiz.question: ____ braggart
quiz.explanation: 吹牛者; 自夸者, 大声吹嘘的人. The loud braggart boasted about his achievements. 大声吹嘘的人夸耀他的成就。 | brag->吹牛（古挪威braga->炫耀），braggart->以吹牛为业的人（cf. boast自夸，bluster虚张声势，brag吹嘘） || 文化联想：中文“吹牛大王”最适合帮助记忆 braggart，可以说 **a loud braggart — “A loud braggart may spend the entire dinner telling everyone how successful he is.”**

quiz.question: ____ rampart
quiz.explanation: 城墙; 壁垒, 城墙. The ancient city rampart still stands today. 古老的城墙至今仍屹立不倒。 | ram->用力夯（古法语rempar），rampart->夯实的防御土墙=城墙（cf. ramp斜坡，rampage狂暴，ram公羊/撞击） || 文化联想：西安古城墙最适合帮助记忆 rampart，可以说 **a city rampart — “Visitors can walk along the broad city rampart surrounding the old center of Xi’an.”**

quiz.question: impart _________
quiz.explanation: 传授; 给予, 传授知识. Teachers impart knowledge to their students. 教师向学生传授知识。 | im->进入，part->部分，impart->给予一部分=传授/赋予（cf. part部分，department部门，partition隔断，apart分开） || 文化联想：“师者，所以传道授业解惑也”最适合帮助记忆 impart，可以说 **impart knowledge — “A good teacher does more than recite facts; she helps impart knowledge in a way students can use.”**

quiz.question: ________ counterpart
quiz.explanation: 对应物; 对等的人, 商业对等方. He met with his business counterpart from Japan. 他与来自日本的商业对等方会面。 | counter->对应，part->部分，counterpart->对应的部分=对等方（cf. counteract抵消，counterbalance平衡，part部分） || 文化联想：中国企业与日本公司谈判时双方职位相当的人最适合帮助记忆 counterpart，可以说 **a business counterpart — “A Chinese executive may meet a Japanese business counterpart who holds a similar role in the partner company.”**

quiz.question: _____ upstart
quiz.explanation: 暴发户; 新贵, 爱出风头的暴发户. The pushy upstart tried to dominate the meeting. 爱出风头的暴发户试图主导会议。 | up->向上，start->突然起步，upstart->突然向上起来的人=暴发户（cf. startup初创公司，start-up新兴，cf. nouveau riche暴发户） || 文化联想：中文“暴发户、新贵急着出风头”最适合帮助记忆 upstart，可以说 **a pushy upstart — “A pushy upstart may try to dominate a meeting despite having little experience.”**

quiz.question: stalwart ____
quiz.explanation: 坚定的; 忠诚的, 坚定的盟友. Britain remained a stalwart ally throughout the war. 英国在整个战争期间一直是坚定的盟友。 | stalwart->坚固的（古英语staelwierthe->有价值的），stalwart->坚定忠诚的（cf. steadfast坚定，staunch忠实，steadfast） || 文化联想：中文“患难见真情”最适合帮助记忆 stalwart，可以说 **a stalwart ally — “A friend who remains beside you during years of difficulty can be a stalwart ally.”**

quiz.question: __________ inert
quiz.explanation: 惰性的; 不活泼的, 化学惰性的. Noble gases are chemically inert elements. 稀有气体是化学惰性元素。 | in->否定，ert->技艺（拉丁ars->技艺），inert->没有技艺/活力的=惰性的（cf. art艺术，inertia惯性，inertness惰性） || 文化联想：中国化学课里的稀有气体最适合帮助记忆 inert，可以说 **chemically inert — “Noble gases are chemically inert because they react only under unusual conditions.”**

quiz.question: subvert ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 颠覆; 破坏, 颠覆国家. Spies tried to subvert the state from within. 间谍试图从内部颠覆国家。 | sub->从下，vert->转，subvert->从下面翻转=颠覆（cf. invert倒置，revert回复，divert转移，pervert歪曲） || 文化联想：中文“从内部破坏根基”最适合帮助记忆 subvert，可以说 **subvert an institution — “Corruption can subvert an institution from within by replacing rules with private favors.”**

quiz.question: advert __
quiz.explanation: 提到; 谈及, 提到. He did not advert to the controversial topic. 他没有提到这个有争议的话题。 | ad->朝向，vert->转，advert->转向提及=提到（cf. advertise广告=把注意力转向，divert转移，revert回复） || 文化联想：advert to 是较正式的“提及/注意到”，可用法律文书语境来记忆，可以说 **advert to a fact — “A judge may advert to a fact mentioned earlier in the written decision.”**

quiz.question: revert __ ____
quiz.explanation: 恢复; 回复, 恢复原状. After the experiment, things will revert to form. 实验后,事情会恢复原状。 | re->回，vert->转，revert->转回去=恢复原状（cf. convert转变，invert倒置，subvert颠覆，pervert歪曲） || 文化联想：中文“恢复原状”最适合帮助记忆 revert，可以说 **revert to form — “After a weak start, an experienced athlete may revert to form and perform at the usual high level.”**

quiz.question: invert ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 倒置; 颠倒, 颠倒顺序. Please invert the order of the list items. 请颠倒列表项目的顺序。 | in->进入（此处=反转），vert->转，invert->反转=倒置（cf. revert回复，subvert颠覆，divert转移，extrovert外向） || 文化联想：中国学生做图像处理时常把黑白反相最适合帮助记忆 invert，可以说 **invert the colors — “An image editor can invert the colors so light areas become dark and dark areas become light.”**

quiz.question: controvert _ _____
quiz.explanation: 反驳; 争论, 反驳声明. Evidence was presented to controvert a claim. 提出了证据来反驳声明。 | contro->对抗，vert->转，controvert->转而对抗=反驳（cf. controversy争议，incontrovertible无可争辩，convert转变） || 文化联想：中文“公开反驳一个主张”最适合帮助记忆 controvert，可以说 **controvert a claim — “A researcher may controvert a claim by presenting stronger evidence from a larger dataset.”**

quiz.question: ________ extrovert
quiz.explanation: 外向的人, 外向的人. She is an outgoing extrovert who loves socializing. 她是一个喜欢社交的外向的人。 | extro->向外，vert->转，extrovert->向外转=外向（cf. introvert内向，invert倒置，divert转移，cf. Jung荣格创造此词对） || 文化联想：中文“外向、见谁都能聊”最适合帮助记忆 extrovert，可以说 **an outgoing extrovert — “An outgoing extrovert may feel energized by a crowded dinner full of conversation and new people.”**

quiz.question: pervert ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 歪曲; 败坏, 歪曲真相. Do not pervert the truth to suit your agenda. 不要歪曲真相以适应你的议程。 | per->彻底/错误地，vert->转，pervert->彻底转错=歪曲（cf. convert转变，subvert颠覆，invert倒置，revert回复） || 文化联想：中文“歪曲真相”最适合帮助记忆 pervert，可以说 **pervert the truth — “Selective editing can pervert the truth by making an event appear very different from what actually happened.”**

quiz.question: ________ fort
quiz.explanation: 堡垒; 要塞, 边境堡垒. Soldiers defended the frontier fort bravely. 士兵们勇敢地守卫边境堡垒。 | fort->强（拉丁fortis->强壮），fort->强固的防御建筑=堡垒（cf. fortress要塞，fortify加强，effort努力，comfort安慰） || 文化联想：中国西北边塞要塞最适合帮助记忆 fort，可以说 **a frontier fort — “An ancient frontier fort could guard a strategic pass and shelter soldiers stationed far from the capital.”**

quiz.question: exhort ___ ____
quiz.explanation: 劝告; 敦促, 劝诫团队. The coach will exhort the team to try harder. 教练会劝诫团队更加努力。 | ex->向外，hort->鼓励（拉丁hortari），exhort->大力鼓励=劝诫（cf. horticulture园艺=鼓励植物生长，exhortation劝告） || 文化联想：中文“给队员打气、鼓励他们坚持”最适合帮助记忆 exhort，可以说 **exhort the team — “A coach may exhort the team to stay focused during the final minutes of a close match.”**

quiz.question: deport _ ________
quiz.explanation: 驱逐出境, 驱逐罪犯. Immigration will deport a criminal to his home country. 移民局将把罪犯驱逐回祖国。 | de->离开，port->携带/港口，deport->携带出境=驱逐（cf. export出口，import进口，transport运输，deportment举止） || 文化联想：deport 是法律上的驱逐出境，可用移民法课堂来记忆，可以说 **deport a foreign national — “Under some legal systems, authorities may seek to deport a foreign national after a qualifying immigration violation.”**

quiz.question: comport _______
quiz.explanation: 举止; 表现, 举止得体. One should comport oneself with dignity. 一个人应该举止得体。 | com->共同，port->携带，comport->以某种方式携带自己=举止（cf. deportment举止，import进口，transport运输） || 文化联想：中文“举止得体”最适合帮助记忆 comport，可以说 **comport oneself with dignity — “At a formal ceremony, a representative is expected to comport oneself with dignity.”**

quiz.question: _____ rapport
quiz.explanation: 融洽; 和谐, 建立融洽关系. It takes time to build rapport with clients. 与客户建立融洽关系需要时间。 | rapport->报告/关系（法语，re+apporter->带回），rapport->相互呼应的融洽关系（注意t不发音，cf. report报告） || 文化联想：中国商务文化里先建立信任和默契最适合帮助记忆 rapport，可以说 **build rapport — “A salesperson may spend time listening carefully in order to build rapport with a new client.”**

quiz.question: purport __
quiz.explanation: 声称; 意图, 声称. The document purport to be an official record. 该文件声称是官方记录。 | pur->朝向，port->携带，purport->携带着某种意图=声称（cf. import进口，export出口，transport运输，purported所谓的） || 文化联想：中文“号称是、据称是”最适合帮助记忆 purport，可以说 **purport to be — “A forged document may purport to be an official certificate even though it is fake.”**

quiz.question: disport _______
quiz.explanation: 嬉戏; 娱乐, 嬉戏玩乐. Children disport oneself on the beach. 孩子们在海滩上嬉戏玩乐。 | dis->分开/离开，port->携带，disport->把自己带开=娱乐嬉戏（cf. sport运动=嬉戏的缩写，disport=sport词源） || 文化联想：中文“孩子们尽情嬉戏”最适合帮助记忆 disport，可以说 **disport oneself — “In older literary English, children who play freely beside a lake might be said to disport themselves.”**

quiz.question: extort _____
quiz.explanation: 勒索; 敲诈, 勒索金钱. Criminals tried to extort money from the business. 罪犯试图从企业勒索金钱。 | ex->向外，tort->扭（拉丁torquere），extort->向外扭出=勒索（cf. torture折磨，contort扭曲，distort歪曲，retort反驳） || 文化联想：中文“敲诈勒索”最适合帮助记忆 extort，可以说 **extort money — “Criminals may threaten a shop owner in an attempt to extort money.”**

quiz.question: curt _____
quiz.explanation: 简短的; 唐突的, 简短的回复. He gave a curt reply and walked away. 他给了一个简短的回复就走开了。 | curt->短（拉丁curtus->切断的），curt->唐突简短的（cf. curtail削减=切断尾巴，curtains窗帘=切断光线，concise简洁） || 文化联想：中文“冷冰冰地回一句”最适合帮助记忆 curt，可以说 **a curt reply — “A busy manager may give a curt reply that sounds almost rude because it is so abrupt.”**

quiz.question: court _____
quiz.explanation: 法院; 球场, 法院命令. The judge issued a court order for his arrest. 法官发出了逮捕他的法院命令。 | court->围起来的空间（拉丁cohors->围场），court->围起来的场所=法院/球场（cf. courtyard庭院，courtesy礼貌=宫廷礼仪，courtship求爱） || 文化联想：中文“法院命令”最适合帮助记忆 court，可以说 **a court order — “A company may be required by a court order to preserve records related to a lawsuit.”**

quiz.question: _________ bombast
quiz.explanation: 夸大的言辞; 浮夸, 政治浮夸言辞. The speech was full of political bombast. 演讲充满了政治浮夸言辞。 | bombast->棉花填充（法语bombace->棉花），bombast->用棉花填满膨胀=浮夸言辞（cf. bomb炸弹，bombastic浮夸的） || 文化联想：中文“官话套话、夸夸其谈”最适合帮助记忆 bombast，可以说 **political bombast — “A speech full of grand slogans but little substance can sound like political bombast.”**

quiz.question: recast ___ ____
quiz.explanation: 重铸; 改写, 重新分配角色. The director decided to recast the role. 导演决定重新分配角色。 | re->再，cast->投/铸，recast->重新铸造/分配（cf. cast投掷/铸造/演员表，broadcast广播，forecast预报） || 文化联想：中国影视翻拍经典作品时重新设定角色最适合帮助记忆 recast，可以说 **recast the role — “A director may recast the role after deciding that a different actor better fits the character.”**

quiz.question: ____ abreast __
quiz.explanation: 并排; 了解, 了解. Its important to keep abreast of current events. 了解时事很重要。 | abreast->在胸前（a+breast->胸），abreast->并排前行/了解最新（cf. breast胸，keep abreast of与时俱进） || 文化联想：中文“及时掌握最新情况”最适合帮助记忆 abreast，可以说 **keep abreast of — “A software engineer needs to keep abreast of important changes in tools and security practices.”**

quiz.question: _____'_ yeast
quiz.explanation: 酵母, 面包师的酵母. Use fresh bakers yeast for the best bread. 使用新鲜的面包师酵母制作最好的面包。 | yeast->酵母（古英语gist->泡沫），yeast->使面团发酵（cf. feast盛宴，beast野兽，east东方，yeast的gh不发音） || 文化联想：中国面包店发面离不开酵母，最适合帮助记忆 yeast，可以说 **baker’s yeast — “A baker mixes baker’s yeast into dough so it rises before baking.”**

quiz.question: steadfast ______
quiz.explanation: 坚定的; 忠实的, 忠实的朋友. She proved to be a steadfast friend in times of trouble. 在困难时期,她证明是忠实的朋友。 | stead->地点/位置（古英语），fast->固定，steadfast->固定在其位置的=坚定的（cf. instead代替，homestead农场，headstead床头） || 文化联想：中文“患难时仍坚定不移的朋友”最适合帮助记忆 steadfast，可以说 **a steadfast friend — “A steadfast friend may stay beside someone through illness, failure, and financial trouble.”**

quiz.question: blast _______
quiz.explanation: 爆炸; 冲击波, 高炉. The blast furnace operates at high temperatures. 高炉在高温下运行。 | blast->猛烈的吹风（古英语blæst->吹），blast->爆炸/猛烈吹风（cf. blaze火焰，bluster虚张声势，gust阵风） || 文化联想：中国钢铁厂高炉最适合帮助记忆 blast，可以说 **a blast furnace — “A steel plant may use a blast furnace to produce molten iron at extremely high temperatures.”**

quiz.question: ____ iconoclast
quiz.explanation: 打破偶像者; 反传统者, 大胆的反传统者. The bold iconoclast challenged conventional thinking. 大胆的反传统者挑战传统思维。 | icon->图像（希腊），clast->打碎（希腊klan），iconoclast->打碎图像的人=反传统者（cf. icon图标，iconography图像学） || 文化联想：中文“敢于打破成规的人”最适合帮助记忆 iconoclast，可以说 **a bold iconoclast — “An artist who deliberately challenges accepted styles may become known as a bold iconoclast.”**

quiz.question: ____ ballast
quiz.explanation: 压舱物; 镇流器, 船上压舱物. The ship ballast keeps the vessel stable. 船上压舱物保持船只稳定。 | ballast->bare+last（古英语，裸露的负荷），ballast->保持稳定的重物（cf. last最后/持续，load负荷，ballast railway道砟） || 文化联想：中国船舶为了保持稳定会配置压舱物，最适合帮助记忆 ballast，可以说 **ship ballast — “A vessel uses ship ballast to improve stability when cargo weight and sea conditions change.”**

quiz.question: ____ mast
quiz.explanation: 桅杆, 船桅杆. The flag flew from the ship mast. 旗帜从船桅杆上飘扬。 | mast->桅杆（古英语mæst），mast->船上竖立的杆（cf. masthead桅顶，mast cell肥大细胞，flagpole旗杆） || 文化联想：中国帆船上的桅杆最适合帮助记忆 mast，可以说 **a ship mast — “A sailboat’s main sail is supported by a tall ship mast rising from the deck.”**

quiz.question: modest ________
quiz.explanation: 谦虚的; 适度的, 适度的提议. He made a modest proposal for reform. 他提出了适度的改革提议。 | mod->标准/适度（拉丁modus），modest->在标准之内的=谦虚/适度（cf. mode方式，moderate适度，modesty谦逊，immodest无礼） || 文化联想：中文“提一个不激进、比较适度的方案”最适合帮助记忆 modest，可以说 **a modest proposal — “A committee may begin with a modest proposal that changes only one part of the existing policy.”**

quiz.question: manifest _______
quiz.explanation: 明显的; 显示, 天定命运. The concept of manifest destiny shaped American expansion. 天定命运的概念塑造了美国的扩张。 | mani->手，fest->抓（拉丁manifestus->抓手），manifest->抓住手显示=明显/表现（cf. manifesto宣言，manifestation显示） || 文化联想：manifest destiny 是美国历史概念，可用中国学生学习美国西进史时来记忆，可以说 **Manifest Destiny — “In a U.S. history class, Chinese students may learn how Manifest Destiny was used to justify westward expansion.”**

quiz.question: ingest ________
quiz.explanation: 摄取; 吸收, 摄取卡路里. Athletes must ingest calories to maintain energy. 运动员必须摄取卡路里来维持能量。 | in->进入，gest->携带（拉丁gerere），ingest->携带进入身体=摄取（cf. digest消化，suggest建议，congest堵塞，gesture手势） || 文化联想：中国人看热量表时会关注每天摄入多少卡路里，最适合帮助记忆 ingest，可以说 **ingest calories — “Sugary drinks make it easy to ingest calories without feeling very full.”**

quiz.question: _____ congest
quiz.explanation: 充血; 拥塞, 鼻塞. Allergies can cause nasal congest. 过敏会导致鼻塞。 | con->共同，gest->携带，congest->共同携带堵塞=拥塞（cf. digest消化，ingest摄取，suggest建议，gesture手势） || 文化联想：中文“鼻塞”最适合帮助记忆 congest，可以说 **congest the nose — “A cold can congest the nose and make breathing through it difficult.”**

quiz.question: molest _ _____
quiz.explanation: 骚扰; 猥亵, 猥亵未成年人. It is a serious crime to molest a minor. 猥亵未成年人是严重的犯罪。 | molest->使受折磨（拉丁molestus->麻烦的），molest->骚扰伤害（cf. molest侵犯，inviolable不可侵犯的） || 文化联想：molest 在现代英语里常指对未成年人进行性侵害或猥亵，可用法律保护儿童的语境记忆，可以说 **molest a minor — “Child-protection laws impose serious penalties on adults who molest a minor.”**

quiz.question: earnest ____
quiz.explanation: 认真的; 诚挚的, 诚挚的恳求. She made an earnest plea for help. 她发出了诚挚的恳求寻求帮助。 | earnest->认真（古英语eornost），earnest->诚挚认真的（cf. in earnest认真地，earn赚得，earnestness认真） || 文化联想：中文“诚恳恳求”最适合帮助记忆 earnest，可以说 **an earnest plea — “A student may make an earnest plea for another chance after admitting a serious mistake.”**

quiz.question: ______ tempest
quiz.explanation: 暴风雨; 骚动, 狂怒的暴风雨. A raging tempest destroyed several boats. 狂怒的暴风雨摧毁了几艘船。 | tempest->暴风雨（拉丁tempestas->时间/天气），tempest->暴风雨（cf. tempestuous激烈，temperature温度，temporal时间的） || 文化联想：中国沿海台风最适合帮助记忆 tempest，可以说 **a raging tempest — “Fishing boats may return to harbor before a raging tempest reaches the coast.”**

quiz.question: ________ crest
quiz.explanation: 顶峰; 波峰, 山顶. Climbers reached the mountain crest at dawn. 登山者在黎明时到达山顶。 | crest->顶羽（拉丁crista->冠），crest->顶羽/山顶（cf. accolade赞扬，crest家徽，crested有冠的，fallen crest失落的旗帜） || 文化联想：黄山山峰的峰顶最适合帮助记忆 crest，可以说 **a mountain crest — “A hiker may stop on a mountain crest to watch clouds move through the valley below.”**

quiz.question: deforest ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 砍伐森林, 砍伐山林. Logging companies will deforest the hills for timber. 伐木公司会为了木材而砍伐山林。 | de->去除，forest->森林，deforest->去除森林=滥伐（cf. reforest重新造林，afforest开荒造林，forestry林业） || 文化联想：中国生态修复里最怕把山林砍秃，最适合帮助记忆 deforest，可以说 **deforest the hills — “Uncontrolled logging can deforest the hills and increase erosion during heavy rain.”**

quiz.question: arrest _______
quiz.explanation: 逮捕; 阻止, 逮捕令. Police executed an arrest warrant this morning. 警方今天早上执行了逮捕令。 | ar->朝向，rest->停下（拉丁restare），arrest->使停下=逮捕/阻止（cf. rest休息，restrain约束，unrest动乱） || 文化联想：中文“逮捕令”最适合帮助记忆 arrest，可以说 **an arrest warrant — “Police may detain a suspect after a judge issues an arrest warrant.”**

quiz.question: attest __ _______
quiz.explanation: 证明; 证实, 证明质量. Certificates attest to quality of the products. 证书证明产品的质量。 | at->朝向，test->见证（拉丁testis->证人），attest->向...作证=证明（cf. testify作证，testament遗嘱，protest抗议） || 文化联想：中文“可以为质量作证”最适合帮助记忆 attest，可以说 **attest to quality — “Years of reliable use by thousands of customers can attest to the quality of a well-made product.”**

quiz.question: quest ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 探索; 追求, 追求真理. Philosophers engage in a quest for truth. 哲学家们从事追求真理的探索。 | quest->寻求（拉丁quaerere->寻找），quest->追求探索（cf. question疑问，request请求，inquest调查，acquire获取） || 文化联想：中文“求真之路”最适合帮助记忆 quest，可以说 **a quest for truth — “A historian may spend decades on a quest for truth about an event buried in incomplete archives.”**

quiz.question: __________ bequest
quiz.explanation: 遗赠; 遗产, 慈善遗赠. He left a charitable bequest to the hospital. 他向医院留下了慈善遗赠。 | be->使，quest->寻求/遗留，bequest->遗留下来的财物=遗赠（cf. quest寻求，bequeath遗留，request请求） || 文化联想：中国慈善遗赠最适合帮助记忆 bequest，可以说 **a charitable bequest — “A retired teacher may leave a charitable bequest in a will to support rural education.”**

quiz.question: ________ conquest
quiz.explanation: 征服; 占领, 军事征服. The military conquest took many years. 军事征服花了许多年。 | con->完全，quest->寻求，conquest->完全寻求得到=征服（cf. quest探索，request请求，inquest调查，conquer征服） || 文化联想：中国历史课里的军事征服最适合帮助记忆 conquest，可以说 **a military conquest — “A military conquest may expand territory quickly but create long-term problems of governance and resistance.”**

quiz.question: divest ______
quiz.explanation: 剥夺; 撤资, 撤资资产. The company decided to divest assets overseas. 公司决定撤资海外资产。 | di->去除，vest->穿着（拉丁vestire），divest->脱去=剥夺/撤资（cf. invest投资=穿上权力，vest背心，vestment祭服） || 文化联想：中文财经里“剥离非核心资产”最适合帮助记忆 divest，可以说 **divest assets — “A company may divest assets that no longer fit its main business strategy.”**

quiz.question: zest ___ ____
quiz.explanation: 热情; 风味, 对生活的热情. Despite his age, he maintains zest for life. 尽管年事已高,他仍保持对生活的热情。 | zest->橘皮风味（法语zeste->橘皮），zest->增添风味的热情（cf. zesty充满活力，gusto热情，enthusiasm热忱） || 文化联想：中文“活得有滋有味、对生活有热情”最适合帮助记忆 zest，可以说 **a zest for life — “Someone who keeps learning, traveling, and meeting friends in old age may retain a strong zest for life.”**

quiz.question: ______ pacifist
quiz.explanation: 和平主义者, 虔诚的和平主义者. The devout pacifist refused military service. 虔诚的和平主义者拒绝服兵役。 | pac->和平（拉丁pax），fist->使，pacifist->使和平的人=和平主义者（cf. peace和平，pacify使平息，Pacific太平洋） || 文化联想：pacifist 是反对战争的人，可用中国学生学习和平主义思想时来记忆，可以说 **a devout pacifist — “A devout pacifist may reject war on moral grounds even during periods of intense political pressure.”**

quiz.question: ___ gist __ __
quiz.explanation: 要点; 主旨, 要点. Can you explain the gist of it briefly? 你能简要说明要点吗? | gist->要点（古法语gist->所在之处），gist->事情的核心要点（cf. jest玩笑，just正义，gist the gist=要点精髓） || 文化联想：中文“一句话抓住要点”最适合帮助记忆 gist，可以说 **get the gist — “Even without understanding every word, a reader may get the gist of a news article from its main points.”**

quiz.question: _____'_ suffragist
quiz.explanation: 参政权论者, 妇女参政权论者. The womens suffragist fought for voting rights. 妇女参政权论者为投票权而斗争。 | suffrage->投票权（拉丁suffragium->投票），suffragist->争取投票权的人（cf. suffrage选举权，universal suffrage普选权） || 文化联想：suffragist 是争取妇女选举权的历史词，可用中国学生学习英美女权史时来记忆，可以说 **a women’s suffragist — “In a modern-history class, students may read about a women’s suffragist campaigning for the right to vote.”**

quiz.question: _____ ecologist
quiz.explanation: 生态学家, 野外生态学家. The field ecologist studies ecosystems in nature. 野外生态学家在自然界中研究生态系统。 | eco->家（希腊oikos->家），logy->学问，ecologist->研究地球家园的学者=生态学家（cf. ecology生态学，economy经济=家的管理） || 文化联想：中国湿地保护区里的生态学家最适合帮助记忆 ecologist，可以说 **a field ecologist — “A field ecologist may survey birds, plants, water quality, and habitat conditions in a wetland reserve.”**

quiz.question: musicologist _______
quiz.explanation: 音乐学家, 音乐学家讲座. The musicologist lecture covered baroque composers. 音乐学家讲座涵盖了巴洛克作曲家。 | music->音乐（希腊Mousa->缪斯），logy->学问，musicologist->研究音乐的学者（cf. muse沉思/缪斯，museum博物馆=缪斯之地） || 文化联想：中国音乐学院研究传统乐种的学者最适合帮助记忆 musicologist，可以说 **a musicologist lecture — “A musicologist may give a lecture on how regional opera styles developed over several centuries.”**

quiz.question: _____ ornithologist
quiz.explanation: 鸟类学家, 野外鸟类学家. The field ornithologist observed bird migration patterns. 野外鸟类学家观察鸟类迁徙模式。 | ornitho->鸟（希腊ornis），logy->学问，ornithologist->研究鸟类的学者（cf. ornithology鸟类学，Ornith奥秘） || 文化联想：中国自然保护区里记录候鸟的鸟类学家最适合帮助记忆 ornithologist，可以说 **a field ornithologist — “A field ornithologist may spend dawn hours identifying migratory birds by sight and sound.”**

quiz.question: _____ cardiologist
quiz.explanation: 心脏病学家, 心脏病学家. The heart cardiologist diagnosed the condition. 心脏病学家诊断了病情。 | cardio->心脏（希腊kardia），logy->学问，cardiologist->研究心脏的医生（cf. cardiac心脏的，cardiology心脏病学） || 文化联想：中国医院心内科最适合帮助记忆 cardiologist，可以说 **a heart cardiologist — “A patient with chest pain may be referred to a cardiologist for further heart testing.”**

quiz.question: _____ anthropologist
quiz.explanation: 人类学家, 野外人类学家. The field anthropologist lived with remote tribes. 野外人类学家与偏远部落生活在一起。 | anthropo->人类（希腊anthropos），logy->学问，anthropologist->研究人类的学者（cf. anthropology人类学，misanthrope厌世者） || 文化联想：中国人类学家研究不同地区的婚俗、语言和社区生活最适合帮助记忆 anthropologist，可以说 **a field anthropologist — “A field anthropologist may live in a community for months while studying customs, language, and social relationships.”**

quiz.question: _______ _ dermatologist
quiz.explanation: 皮肤科医生, 咨询皮肤科医生. You should consult a dermatologist for skin issues. 你应该咨询皮肤科医生解决皮肤问题。 | dermato->皮肤（希腊derma），logy->学问，dermatologist->研究皮肤的医生（cf. hypodermic皮下，epidermis表皮） || 文化联想：中国医院皮肤科最适合帮助记忆 dermatologist，可以说 **consult a dermatologist — “Someone with a persistent skin rash may consult a dermatologist for diagnosis and treatment.”**

quiz.question: _____ herpetologist
quiz.explanation: 爬行动物学家, 野外爬行动物学家. The field herpetologist studies snakes and lizards. 野外爬行动物学家研究蛇和蜥蜴。 | herpeto->爬行（希腊herpein->爬），logy->学问，herpetologist->研究爬行动物的学者（cf. herpes疱疹=爬行的皮肤病） || 文化联想：中国两栖爬行动物野外调查最适合帮助记忆 herpetologist，可以说 **a field herpetologist — “A field herpetologist may search mountain streams at night for frogs, salamanders, snakes, and lizards.”**

quiz.question: anarchist ________
quiz.explanation: 无政府主义者, 无政府主义运动. The anarchist movement opposed all forms of government. 无政府主义运动反对所有形式的政府。 | an->无，arch->统治（希腊），anarchist->无统治者=无政府主义者（cf. monarchy君主制，oligarchy寡头，hierarchy等级制度） || 文化联想：anarchist 是政治思想史里的“无政府主义者”，可用中国学生学习欧洲近现代政治史时来记忆，可以说 **an anarchist movement — “In a political-history course, students may study an anarchist movement that rejected centralized state authority.”**

quiz.question: ___ vocalist
quiz.explanation: 歌手; 声乐家, 流行歌手. The pop vocalist topped the charts worldwide. 流行歌手在全球排行榜上名列前茅。 | vocal->声音（拉丁vox），ist->人，vocalist->用声音表演的人=歌手（cf. voice声音，invoke祈求，revoke撤销，vocal cord声带） || 文化联想：中国流行音乐舞台上的主唱最适合帮助记忆 vocalist，可以说 **a pop vocalist — “A pop vocalist may spend years training breath control, pitch, and stage performance.”**

quiz.question: ______ instrumentalist
quiz.explanation: 器乐演奏者, 弦乐器演奏者. The string instrumentalist played the violin beautifully. 弦乐器演奏者优美地演奏小提琴。 | instrument->工具（拉丁instrumentum），ist->人，instrumentalist->用乐器演奏的人=器乐演奏者（cf. instrument工具，instrumental工具性的） || 文化联想：中国民族乐团里的二胡、琵琶等演奏者最适合帮助记忆 instrumentalist，可以说 **a string instrumentalist — “A string instrumentalist in a Chinese orchestra may specialize in instruments such as the erhu or pipa.”**

quiz.question: _____ philatelist
quiz.explanation: 集邮家, 邮票集邮家. The stamp philatelist collected rare postage items. 邮票集邮家收集稀有邮政物品。 | philos->热爱，atelia->免税（希腊，ateleia->免邮费），philatelist->热爱免费邮票的人=集邮家（cf. philosophy哲学，philanthropy慈善） || 文化联想：中国人熟悉的集邮册最适合帮助记忆 philatelist，可以说 **a dedicated philatelist — “A dedicated philatelist may spend years collecting rare Chinese stamps and organizing them by date and issue.”**

quiz.question: pugilist ________
quiz.explanation: 拳击手, 拳击冠军. The pugilist champion defended his title successfully. 拳击冠军成功卫冕。 | pugil->拳击手（拉丁pugnus->拳头），pugilist->用拳头战斗的人=拳击手（cf. pugnacious好斗，impugn质疑，repugnant令人厌恶） || 文化联想：中国拳击比赛里的职业拳手最适合帮助记忆 pugilist，可以说 **a seasoned pugilist — “A seasoned pugilist may rely on footwork, timing, and defense rather than simply throwing harder punches.”**

quiz.question: enlist _______
quiz.explanation: 征募; 争取, 争取支持. The campaign will enlist support from local businesses. 该活动将争取当地企业的支持。 | en->使，list->名单，enlist->把名字列入名单=征募/争取（cf. list列表，enroll注册，conscript征召，recruit招募） || 文化联想：中文“争取大家支持”最适合帮助记忆 enlist，可以说 **enlist support — “A community project may enlist support from local businesses, volunteers, and neighborhood groups.”**

quiz.question: _______ extremist
quiz.explanation: 极端主义者, 暴力极端主义者. The violent extremist was arrested by authorities. 暴力极端主义者被当局逮捕。 | extrem->极端（拉丁extremus->最外端的），extremist->持极端立场的人（cf. extreme极端，external外部，exterior外面） || 文化联想：中文“走向极端的人”最适合帮助记忆 extremist，可以说 **a violent extremist — “Authorities may investigate a violent extremist who advocates attacks on civilians.”**

quiz.question: ____ optimist
quiz.explanation: 乐观主义者, 天生的乐观主义者. She is a born optimist who sees the bright side. 她是一个天生的乐观主义者,总看到光明的一面。 | optim->最好（拉丁optimus），optimist->相信事情最好的人=乐观主义者（cf. optimal最优，optimize优化，optimum最佳） || 文化联想：中文“凡事都往好处想”最适合帮助记忆 optimist，可以说 **a born optimist — “A born optimist may see a failed exam as a chance to learn rather than a permanent setback.”**

quiz.question: _____ taxonomist
quiz.explanation: 分类学家, 植物分类学家. The plant taxonomist identified new species. 植物分类学家鉴定了新物种。 | taxo->排列（希腊taxis），nom->法则，taxonomist->按法则排列的学者=分类学家（cf. taxonomy分类学，syntax句法，tactics战术） || 文化联想：中国植物园给新物种分类的学者最适合帮助记忆 taxonomist，可以说 **a plant taxonomist — “A plant taxonomist may compare leaves, flowers, seeds, and DNA before identifying a new species.”**

quiz.question: ______ conformist
quiz.explanation: 墨守成规者, 社会墨守成规者. The social conformist follows all societal norms. 社会墨守成规者遵循所有社会规范。 | con->共同，form->形式，conformist->跟随共同形式的人=循规蹈矩者（cf. reform改革，transform转变，inform通知） || 文化联想：中文“随大流、守旧规矩的人”最适合帮助记忆 conformist，可以说 **a social conformist — “A social conformist may follow established customs simply because everyone around him does the same.”**

quiz.question: ______ nonconformist

The exhibition runs the full gamut of modern art. 展览涵盖了现代艺术的全部范围。 | gamut->音阶全范围（中世纪音乐gamma+ut，整个音阶），gamut->全部范围（cf. gamma希腊字母，scale音阶，full gamut全部范围） || 文化联想：中文“从头到尾、整个范围都包括”最适合帮助记忆 gamut，可以说 **run the full gamut — “A large museum exhibition may run the full gamut from ancient bronzes to contemporary digital art.”**

quiz.question: ______ bout
quiz.explanation: 回合; 一场, 拳击比赛. The boxing bout lasted twelve rounds. 拳击比赛持续了十二回合。 | bout->转（古法语bouter->推），bout->一个回合的比赛（cf. about关于=在周围，button纽扣=推进，debate辩论） || 文化联想：中国拳击比赛的一场完整对决最适合帮助记忆 bout，可以说 **a boxing bout — “A championship boxing bout may last several rounds and test both endurance and strategy.”**

quiz.question: roundabout _____
quiz.explanation: 环形交叉路; 迂回的, 迂回路线. We took a roundabout route to avoid traffic. 我们走迂回路线以避免交通拥堵。 | round->圆，about->关于/在周围，roundabout->绕着圆圈转=环形交叉路/迂回的（cf. circle圆，rotary环形道） || 文化联想：中文“绕了个大圈子”最适合帮助记忆 roundabout，可以说 **a roundabout route — “To avoid a traffic jam, a driver may take a roundabout route through several smaller streets.”**

quiz.question: _______ lout
quiz.explanation: 粗人; 笨蛋, 粗鲁的粗人. The boorish lout offended everyone at the party. 粗鲁的粗人冒犯了聚会上的每个人。 | lout->笨拙者（古英语lutan->弯腰），lout->笨拙粗鲁的人（cf. oaf笨蛋，boor粗人，loutish粗鲁的） || 文化联想：中文“粗鲁没教养的人”最适合帮助记忆 lout，可以说 **a boorish lout — “A boorish lout may shout at servers, interrupt other guests, and ruin a pleasant dinner.”**

quiz.question: pout ____
quiz.explanation: 撅嘴; 生气, 撅起嘴唇. Children often pout lips when disappointed. 孩子们失望时常常撅起嘴唇。 | pout->撅嘴（中古英语pouten->突出），pout->嘴唇突出=撅嘴（cf. spout喷出，sprout发芽，clout影响力） || 文化联想：中国孩子闹别扭时撅嘴最适合帮助记忆 pout，可以说 **pout one’s lips — “A disappointed child may pout his lips after being told that no more candy will be bought.”**

quiz.question: _ rout
quiz.explanation: 溃败; 彻底击败, 一场溃败. The battle ended in a rout of the enemy. 战斗以敌人的溃败告终。 | rout->溃败（古法语route->道路被打开），rout->敌军溃逃（cf. route路线，routine常规，disrupt扰乱） || 文化联想：中文“兵败如山倒”最适合帮助记忆 rout，可以说 **end in a rout — “A battle can end in a rout when one side breaks formation and flees in panic.”**

quiz.question: tout _ _______
quiz.explanation: 兜售; 吹捧, 兜售产品. Advertisers tout a product as revolutionary. 广告商兜售产品称其具有革命性。 | tout->四处张望（古英语tutan->探望），tout->四处张望招揽顾客=兜售（cf. touter招揽者，toot吹号，tout张扬） || 文化联想：中文“把产品吹得天花乱坠”最适合帮助记忆 tout，可以说 **tout a product — “An influencer may tout a product as revolutionary even when the actual improvement is minor.”**

quiz.question: stout _____
quiz.explanation: 粗壮的; 结实的, 结实的体格. The wrestler had a stout build. 摔跤手有结实的体格。 | stout->骄傲/强壮（古法语estout->大胆），stout->结实粗壮（cf. stalwart坚定，robust强壮，sturdy结实，stout啤酒） || 文化联想：中国摔跤运动员结实体格最适合帮助记忆 stout，可以说 **a stout build — “A heavyweight wrestler may have a stout build with a thick torso and powerful legs.”**

quiz.question: devout ________
quiz.explanation: 虔诚的, 虔诚的信徒. She is a devout believer who prays daily. 她是一位每天祈祷的虔诚信徒。 | de->完全，vout->誓愿（拉丁votum），devout->完全发誓奉献的=虔诚的（cf. vow誓言，vote投票，devote奉献，devotion奉献） || 文化联想：devout 是宗教虔诚，可用中国教堂里的信徒来记忆，可以说 **a devout believer — “A devout believer may attend worship regularly and pray every day.”**

quiz.question: ____ plateau
quiz.explanation: 高原; 平稳期, 高原. The high plateau stretches for miles. 高原绵延数英里。 | plat->平坦（法语，拉丁platus），plateau->平坦的高地=高原（注意au不发音，cf. plate盘子，platform平台，flat平坦） || 文化联想：青藏高原最适合帮助记忆 plateau，可以说 **a high plateau — “The Tibetan Plateau is a vast high plateau with an average elevation far above most surrounding regions.”**

quiz.question: _____ purlieu
quiz.explanation: 范围; 郊区, 乡村地区. They lived in the rural purlieu outside the city. 他们住在城市外的乡村地区。 | pur->通过，lieu->地方（法语），purlieu->通过的地方=周边地区（cf. lieu代替，lieutenant副官=代位者，milieu环境=中间地方） || 文化联想：中文“城市外围、郊野周边”最适合帮助记忆 purlieu，可以说 **a rural purlieu — “A family may choose to live in a rural purlieu outside the city where fields and villages are still nearby.”**

quiz.question: ____ guru
quiz.explanation: 大师; 权威, 技术大师. The tech guru founded several startups. 技术大师创立了几家初创公司。 | guru->重的/有分量的（梵语，来自Sanskrit guru），guru->有分量的老师=大师（cf. grave严肃/重的，gravitas庄严，gravity重力） || 文化联想：中文“技术大神”最适合帮助记忆 guru，可以说 **a tech guru — “A well-known tech guru may attract large audiences by explaining difficult software ideas in simple language.”**

quiz.question: impromptu ______
quiz.explanation: 即兴的, 即兴演讲. She delivered an impromptu speech at the event. 她在活动中发表了即兴演讲。 | in->否定，promptu->提示（拉丁in promptu->随时准备着），impromptu->没有事先准备的=即兴的（cf. prompt提示，prompter提词员） || 文化联想：中国会议上临时被点名发言最适合帮助记忆 impromptu，可以说 **an impromptu speech — “A manager may give an impromptu speech after unexpectedly being asked to say a few words.”**

quiz.question: ______ thaw
quiz.explanation: 解冻; 融化, 春季解冻. The spring thaw melts the snow. 春季解冻融化了雪。 | thaw->融化（古英语þawian），thaw->冰雪融化（cf. thaw out解冻，political thaw政治解冻，thaw=melt融化） || 文化联想：中国北方春天冰雪消融最适合帮助记忆 thaw，可以说 **the spring thaw — “The spring thaw can soften frozen ground and raise water levels in rivers and streams.”**

quiz.question: _____ flaw
quiz.explanation: 缺陷; 瑕疵, 致命缺陷. The plan had a fatal flaw that doomed it. 该计划有一个注定失败的致命缺陷。 | flaw->裂缝（古挪威flaga->薄片），flaw->破裂处=缺陷（cf. flaw缺陷，flawed有缺陷的，flawless无瑕疵的） || 文化联想：中文“一处致命漏洞毁掉整个方案”最适合帮助记忆 flaw，可以说 **a fatal flaw — “A business plan may fail because of a fatal flaw that no one noticed during early planning.”**

quiz.question: withdraw ____
quiz.explanation: 取出; 撤回, 取现金. You can withdraw cash from the ATM. 你可以从自动取款机取现金。 | with->反向，draw->拉，withdraw->向反方向拉=取出/撤回（cf. withstand抵抗，withhold扣留，draw拉） || 文化联想：中国银行ATM取现金最适合帮助记忆 withdraw，可以说 **withdraw cash — “A traveler may withdraw cash from an ATM before visiting a place where mobile payment is not accepted.”**

quiz.question: jigsaw ______
quiz.explanation: 拼图, 拼图游戏. Children enjoy solving jigsaw puzzle. 孩子们喜欢解拼图游戏。 | jig->上下跳动，saw->锯，jigsaw->上下抖动的锯=曲线锯（切出不规则拼图形状，cf. jigsaw blade曲线锯片） || 文化联想：中国孩子拼一千片拼图最适合帮助记忆 jigsaw，可以说 **a jigsaw puzzle — “A family may spend several evenings completing a thousand-piece jigsaw puzzle together.”**

quiz.question: yaw _____
quiz.explanation: 偏航, 偏航误差. The pilot corrected the yaw error. 飞行员纠正了偏航误差。 | yaw->偏航（古挪威jaga->摇摆），yaw->船/飞机偏离航线（cf. pitch俯仰，roll滚动，yaw偏航=飞行三轴运动） || 文化联想：中国航空航天课堂里的偏航误差最适合帮助记忆 yaw，可以说 **a yaw error — “A flight-control system may correct a yaw error when an aircraft begins turning away from its intended heading.”**

quiz.question: ____ curfew
quiz.explanation: 宵禁, 城市宵禁. The city curfew begins at midnight. 城市宵禁从午夜开始。 | couvre->盖（法语），feu->火，curfew->盖住火=宵禁（中世纪每晚敲钟提醒市民熄灭炉火，cf. cover覆盖，focus炉火） || 文化联想：curfew 是宵禁，可用战争或紧急状态下的城市管理来记忆，可以说 **a city curfew — “During a serious emergency, authorities may impose a city curfew that requires residents to stay indoors after midnight.”**

quiz.question: eschew ________
quiz.explanation: 避免; 戒绝, 避免暴力. Peaceful protesters eschew violence completely. 和平抗议者完全避免暴力。 | eschew->回避（古高德语sciuhan->害怕），eschew->刻意回避（cf. shy害羞，shun回避，skew偏斜） || 文化联想：中文“敬而远之、主动避开”最适合帮助记忆 eschew，可以说 **eschew violence — “A peaceful movement may explicitly eschew violence and rely on lawful protest and negotiation.”**

quiz.question: skew ____
quiz.explanation: 歪斜; 扭曲, 扭曲数据. Bias can skew data in research studies. 偏见会扭曲研究中的数据。 | skew->歪斜（古挪威skeifr->斜），skew->使偏斜（cf. askew歪斜的，oblique斜的，eschew回避） || 文化联想：中文“样本偏差把数据带歪”最适合帮助记忆 skew，可以说 **skew the data — “A survey that reaches only one type of respondent may skew the data and produce a misleading conclusion.”**

quiz.question: _ slew __ ______
quiz.explanation: 大量; 许多, 大量订单. The company received a slew of orders. 公司收到了大量订单。 | slew->大批（爱尔兰语slua->人群），a slew of->大量的（cf. slew杀死->slay的过去式，two meanings） || 文化联想：中文“一大堆订单一下子涌来”最适合帮助记忆 slew，可以说 **a slew of orders — “A livestream promotion may generate a slew of orders within only a few minutes.”**

quiz.question: ______ sinew
quiz.explanation: 肌腱; 力量, 肌肉肌腱. The athletes muscle sinew was well developed. 运动员的肌肉肌腱发育良好。 | sinew->筋/肌腱（古英语sinu），sinew->力量的来源（cf. sinewy强健的，the sinews of war战争的资源，nerve神经） || 文化联想：中文“筋骨强健”最适合帮助记忆 sinew，可以说 **strong sinew — “Traditional descriptions of a powerful athlete often emphasize strong sinew and solid muscle.”**

quiz.question: _______ ___ screw
quiz.explanation: 螺丝, 拧紧螺丝. Use a screwdriver to tighten the screw. 用螺丝刀拧紧螺丝。 | screw->螺丝（法语escroue->螺帽），screw->螺旋形的紧固件（cf. screw拧，unscrew拆开，corkscrew开瓶器） || 文化联想：中国家里修家具时拧紧螺丝最适合帮助记忆 screw，可以说 **tighten the screw — “A homeowner may use a screwdriver to tighten the screw on a loose cabinet hinge.”**

quiz.question: elbow ____
quiz.explanation: 肘部, 活动空间. The small office provides little elbow room. 小办公室几乎没有活动空间。 | el->前臂，bow->弯（古英语elboga），elbow->手臂的弯曲处=肘（cf. bow弯曲，elbow one's way用肘挤路，elbow room活动空间） || 文化联想：中文“小办公室挤得转不开身”最适合帮助记忆 elbow，可以说 **little elbow room — “A tiny office packed with desks may leave workers with very little elbow room.”**

quiz.question: cow ____ _______
quiz.explanation: 威吓; 恐吓, 威吓使沉默. Threats cannot cow into silence brave journalists. 威胁无法威吓勇敢的记者使其沉默。 | cow->恐吓（古挪威kúga->压制），cow->把人压制=威吓（注意与cow母牛无关，cf. intimidate恐吓，bully欺凌） || 文化联想：中文“威逼得不敢说话”最适合帮助记忆 cow，可以说 **cow into silence — “Threats may be used to cow a witness into silence, though intimidation is improper and often illegal.”**

quiz.question: foreshadow ______
quiz.explanation: 预示; 预兆, 预示事件. Dark clouds foreshadow events of the storm. 乌云预示风暴事件。 | fore->提前，shadow->影子，foreshadow->提前投下影子=预示（cf. shadow影子，shadow boxing空击，overshadow压倒） || 文化联想：中文“乌云压城，预示暴雨将至”最适合帮助记忆 foreshadow，可以说 **foreshadow trouble — “Dark clouds gathering over the mountains may foreshadow trouble before a severe storm arrives.”**

quiz.question: overshadow ____________
quiz.explanation: 使黯然失色; 遮蔽, 使成就黯然失色. Do not let failure overshadow achievements. 不要让失败使成就黯然失色。 | over->在上，shadow->影子，overshadow->从上面投下影子=使黯然失色（cf. shadow影子，foreshadow预示，shade阴影） || 文化联想：中文“别让一次失败盖过所有成绩”最适合帮助记忆 overshadow，可以说 **overshadow achievements — “One disappointing result should not overshadow achievements built through years of hard work.”**

quiz.question: endow ____
quiz.explanation: 捐赠; 赋予, 捐赠基金. The philanthropist will endow fund for scholarships. 慈善家将为奖学金捐赠基金。 | en->使，dow->给予（古英语dagian->给嫁妆），endow->给予财产=捐赠（cf. dowry嫁妆，endowment捐赠，widow寡妇） || 文化联想：中国慈善家捐资设立奖学金最适合帮助记忆 endow，可以说 **endow a scholarship fund — “A philanthropist may endow a scholarship fund so students can receive support for many years.”**

quiz.question: _________ know-how
quiz.explanation: 专门技术; 实践知识, 技术诀窍. Engineers possess technical know-how. 工程师拥有技术诀窍。 | know->知道，how->如何，know-how->知道如何做=诀窍（cf. know-how实践知识，expertise专业知识，skill技能） || 文化联想：中文“老师傅的真本事、实操经验”最适合帮助记忆 know-how，可以说 **technical know-how — “An experienced engineer may possess technical know-how that cannot be learned from textbooks alone.”**

quiz.question: ________ sideshow
quiz.explanation: 杂耍; 附属活动, 嘉年华杂耍. The carnival sideshow attracted curious crowds. 嘉年华杂耍吸引了好奇的人群。 | side->旁边，show->表演，sideshow->旁边的附属表演=杂耍（cf. showcase展示，showdown摊牌，sideline边线/旁观） || 文化联想：中文“主菜旁边的小节目”最适合帮助记忆 sideshow，可以说 **a carnival sideshow — “At an old-fashioned fair, a carnival sideshow may attract curious visitors away from the main event.”**

quiz.question: overflow ____
quiz.explanation: 溢出; 泛滥, 溢流罐. The overflow tank collects excess water. 溢流罐收集多余的水。 | over->超过，flow->流，overflow->流过头=溢出（cf. overflowing满溢，overflow of emotions情绪溢出，underflow潜流） || 文化联想：中国水箱里多余的水进入溢流罐最适合帮助记忆 overflow，可以说 **an overflow tank — “An overflow tank collects excess water when pressure or temperature causes the main system to expand.”**

quiz.question: ____ glow
quiz.explanation: 发光; 光辉, 柔和的光辉. Candles cast a soft glow in the room. 蜡烛在房间里投射出柔和的光辉。 | glow->发光（古英语glowan），glow->温暖发光（cf. glowing赞美的/发光的，afterglow余晖，radiate辐射） || 文化联想：春节夜晚红灯笼发出的柔和光最适合帮助记忆 glow，可以说 **a soft glow — “Red lanterns may cast a soft glow across a courtyard on a winter evening.”**

quiz.question: callow _____
quiz.explanation: 未成熟的; 无经验的, 未成熟的青年. The callow youth lacked worldly experience. 未成熟的青年缺乏世俗经验。 | callow->秃（古英语calu->没有羽毛），callow->没长羽毛的雏鸟=幼稚无经验的（cf. bald秃头，callow youth乳臭未干的年轻人） || 文化联想：中文“乳臭未干、涉世未深”最适合帮助记忆 callow，可以说 **a callow youth — “A callow youth may speak confidently about life despite having very little real-world experience.”**

quiz.question: fallow _____
quiz.explanation: 休耕的; 荒芜的, 休耕田地. The farmer left the fallow field to recover. 农民让休耕田地恢复。 | fallow->淡黄（古英语fealu->淡黄色），fallow->颜色如休耕地的枯黄=休耕（cf. fellow伙伴=同一块地的人，follow跟随，fallow land休耕地） || 文化联想：中国传统农业里让田地休耕养地最适合帮助记忆 fallow，可以说 **a fallow field — “A farmer may leave a field fallow for a season so the soil can recover.”**

quiz.question: hallow ___ ______
quiz.explanation: 使神圣; 尊崇, 使土地神圣. They will hallow the ground with a ceremony. 他们将用仪式使土地神圣。 | hallow->神圣（古英语halig->圣），hallow->使神圣（cf. Halloween万圣节前夕=圣者之夜，holy神圣，hallowed神圣的土地） || 文化联想：中国祭祖或纪念仪式里把一处地方视为庄严神圣最适合帮助记忆 hallow，可以说 **hallow the ground — “A memorial ceremony may hallow the ground by treating it as a place of remembrance and respect.”**

quiz.question: minnow ____
quiz.explanation: 小鱼; 小人物, 小鱼池塘. The minnow pond teems with tiny fish. 小鱼池塘里到处都是小鱼。 | minnow->小鱼（中古英语menow），minnow->极小的鱼/小人物（cf. big fish in a small pond大池塘里的小鱼，小池里的大鱼） || 文化联想：中国乡间小溪里的小鱼最适合帮助记忆 minnow，可以说 **a tiny minnow — “A child may spot a tiny minnow darting through the clear water of a shallow stream.”**

quiz.question: winnow ____
quiz.explanation: 筛选; 扬谷, 筛选数据. Researchers must winnow data to find patterns. 研究人员必须筛选数据以找到模式。 | winnow->扬谷（古英语windwian->用风吹），winnow->用风吹去谷壳=筛选（cf. wind风，window窗户=风眼，winnowing扬谷） || 文化联想：中国农村扬谷时用风把谷壳筛掉最适合帮助记忆 winnow，可以说 **winnow the grain — “Traditional farmers may winnow the grain by tossing it so the wind carries away the lighter chaff.”**

quiz.question: highbrow _______
quiz.explanation: 知识分子的; 高雅的, 高雅文化. The magazine covers highbrow culture and arts. 该杂志涵盖高雅文化和艺术。 | high->高，brow->眉毛/额头，highbrow->额头高=知识分子（颅相学认为额头高=聪明，cf. lowbrow通俗，middlebrow中等） || 文化联想：中国学生说“阳春白雪”时可帮助记忆 highbrow，可以说 **highbrow culture — “Opera, classical literature, and academic criticism may be described as highbrow culture, though the label can sound slightly elitist.”**

quiz.question: overthrow _ ______
quiz.explanation: 推翻; 打倒, 推翻政权. Rebels attempted to overthrow a regime. 叛军试图推翻政权。 | over->超过，throw->投掷，overthrow->向外投掷推翻=推翻（cf. throwback倒退，throw light on阐明，overthrow推翻政权） || 文化联想：中国历史里“推翻旧政权”最适合帮助记忆 overthrow，可以说 **overthrow a regime — “A revolutionary movement may attempt to overthrow a regime that has lost political legitimacy.”**

quiz.question: farrow _ ______
quiz.explanation: 产仔, 产一窝仔. The sow will farrow a litter in spring. 母猪将在春天产一窝仔。 | farrow->一窝猪仔（古英语fearh->小猪），farrow->母猪产仔（cf. farrow母猪产仔，cf. feral野生，litter一窝幼崽/垃圾） || 文化联想：中国农村母猪春天产下一窝小猪最适合帮助记忆 farrow，可以说 **farrow a litter — “A healthy sow may farrow a litter of piglets in a warm, clean pen.”**

quiz.question: harrow ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 耙地; 折磨, 耙地. Farmers harrow the field before planting. 农民在种植前耙地。 | harrow->耙（古英语hærwe），harrow->用耙耕地/使痛苦（cf. harrowing令人痛苦的，harrow耙地，Halloween=harrowing night） || 文化联想：中国农民春耕前用耙子整地最适合帮助记忆 harrow，可以说 **harrow the field — “Before sowing, a farmer may harrow the field to break clods and level the soil.”**

quiz.question: ____ marrow
quiz.explanation: 骨髓; 精髓, 骨髓. Bone marrow produces blood cells. 骨髓产生血细胞。 | marrow->髓（古英语mearg），marrow->骨髓/精髓（cf. vegetable marrow西葫芦，chilled to the marrow透心凉，marrow of a matter精髓） || 文化联想：中国医院骨髓检查最适合帮助记忆 marrow，可以说 **bone marrow — “Bone marrow inside many bones produces important blood cells.”**

quiz.question: sow _____
quiz.explanation: 播种, 播种种子. Spring is the time to sow seeds. 春天是播种种子的时候。 | sow->播种（古英语sawan），sow seeds->播下种子（cf. sow播种=sow the seeds of discord播下争端的种子，reap收获） || 文化联想：中文“春种一粒粟”最适合帮助记忆 sow，可以说 **sow seeds — “A farmer may sow seeds in spring and wait for the first green shoots to appear.”**

quiz.question: bestow _____
quiz.explanation: 授予; 给予, 授予荣誉. The university will bestow honor on the graduate. 大学将授予毕业生荣誉。 | be->使，stow->放置，bestow->把某物放置给某人=授予（cf. stow收放，stowage货物放置，stow away偷乘） || 文化联想：中国大学给杰出校友授予荣誉最适合帮助记忆 bestow，可以说 **bestow an honor — “A university may bestow an honor on a scientist whose work has benefited society.”**

quiz.question: avow _____
quiz.explanation: 承认; 公开宣称, 承认罪责. The defendant chose to avow guilt. 被告选择承认罪责。 | a->朝向，vow->誓言（拉丁votum），avow->公开发誓=公开承认（cf. vow誓言，devout虔诚，avowed公开的） || 文化联想：中文“公开承认，不再遮掩”最适合帮助记忆 avow，可以说 **avow responsibility — “A leader may avow responsibility for a failed decision instead of blaming subordinates.”**

quiz.question: disavow _________
quiz.explanation: 否认; 拒绝承认, 否认知情. The official will disavow knowledge of the scandal. 官员将否认知情这起丑闻。 | dis->否定，avow->承认，disavow->否认承认=拒绝承认（cf. avow承认，disown断绝关系，deny否认） || 文化联想：中文“公开否认与某事有关”最适合帮助记忆 disavow，可以说 **disavow knowledge — “An official may disavow knowledge of a secret arrangement and insist that it was never authorized.”**

quiz.question: flax _____
quiz.explanation: 亚麻, 亚麻纤维. Linen is made from flax fiber. 亚麻布由亚麻纤维制成。 | flax->亚麻（古英语fleax），flax->亚麻植物（cf. linen亚麻布，flaxen淡黄色，flexible柔软=像亚麻一样） || 文化联想：中国传统亚麻纺织最适合帮助记忆 flax，可以说 **flax fiber — “Linen cloth is made from flax fiber that is processed, spun, and woven into fabric.”**

quiz.question: _____ _ climax
quiz.explanation: 高潮; 顶点, 达到高潮. The tension will reach a climax in the final act. 紧张气氛将在最后一幕达到高潮。 | climax->梯子（希腊klimax->梯子），climax->爬到最高点=高潮（cf. climb攀爬，climate气候=倾斜的太阳，acclimate适应气候） || 文化联想：中文“剧情终于推到最高点”最适合帮助记忆 climax，可以说 **reach a climax — “The tension in a historical drama may reach a climax when the final secret is revealed.”**

quiz.question: ____ anticlimax
quiz.explanation: 反高潮; 虎头蛇尾, 情节反高潮. The ending was a disappointing plot anticlimax. 结局是令人失望的情节反高潮。 | anti->对抗，climax->高潮，anticlimax->高潮的对立=反高潮/虎头蛇尾（cf. climax高潮，anticlimactic令人失望的） || 文化联想：中文“虎头蛇尾”最适合帮助记忆 anticlimax，可以说 **a disappointing anticlimax — “After two hours of buildup, an ending in which nothing important happens can feel like a disappointing anticlimax.”**

quiz.question: ________ apex
quiz.explanation: 顶点; 最高点, 山顶. Climbers reached the mountain apex at noon. 登山者在中午到达山顶。 | apex->顶点（拉丁，帽子的顶端），apex->最高点（cf. apogee最远点，aphelion远日点，cf. apex predator顶级捕食者） || 文化联想：泰山或华山最高点的概念最适合帮助记忆 apex，可以说 **the mountain apex — “Climbers may reach the mountain apex just before sunrise and look down over the surrounding ridges.”**

quiz.question: ________ vertex
quiz.explanation: 顶点; 角的顶点, 三角形顶点. The triangle vertex is labeled point A. 三角形顶点标记为A点。 | vert->转（拉丁vertere），vertex->旋转的顶端=顶点（cf. vortex漩涡，vertical垂直，vertigo眩晕=旋转感） || 文化联想：中国中学几何课里的三角形顶点最适合帮助记忆 vertex，可以说 **a triangle vertex — “A geometry teacher may label each triangle vertex with a different capital letter.”**

quiz.question: vex ___ ______
quiz.explanation: 使烦恼; 使恼怒, 使公众烦恼. The controversy will vex the public for months. 这场争议将使公众烦恼数月。 | vex->骚扰（拉丁vexare->摇晃），vex->使烦恼（cf. vexation烦恼，vexatious令人烦恼的，vexed question棘手问题） || 文化联想：中文“这件事让公众烦了几个月”最适合帮助记忆 vex，可以说 **vex the public — “Repeated delays and contradictory announcements may vex the public for months.”**

quiz.question: convex ______
quiz.explanation: 凸的; 凸面的, 凸面镜. The convex mirror provides a wide view. 凸面镜提供广阔的视野。 | con->共同，vex->拱起（拉丁vehere->携带），convex->向外拱起的=凸的（cf. concave凹面，convex凸面，excavate挖掘） || 文化联想：中国停车场或路口的凸面镜最适合帮助记忆 convex，可以说 **a convex mirror — “A convex mirror at a blind corner gives drivers a wider view of approaching traffic.”**

quiz.question: prolix ______
quiz.explanation: 冗长的; 啰嗦的, 冗长的演讲. His prolix speech bored the audience. 他冗长的演讲使观众感到厌烦。 | pro->向前，lix->流动（拉丁liqui），prolix->话语像水一样流个不停=冗长的（cf. liquid液体，liquor酒，prolixity啰嗦） || 文化联想：中文“又臭又长、啰里啰嗦”最适合帮助记忆 prolix，可以说 **a prolix speech — “A prolix speech may bury one simple idea under forty minutes of unnecessary explanation.”**
